sourceRange.text: 論曰：昔魏氏失馭，中原蕩析。齊神武爰從晉部，大號冀方。屢戰而翦凶徒，一麾以清京洛。尊主匡國，功濟天下。既而魏武帝規避權逼，歷數既盡，適所以速關、河之分焉。

context.beforeSource: 至南威梁國，北懷蠕蠕，吐谷渾、阿至羅咸所招納，獲其力用，規略遠矣。
context.afterSource: 全文以中華書局、一九七二年十一月、第一版《北齊書》為本校。

manualTranslations.zh: 論曰：昔魏氏失馭，中原蕩析。
manualTranslations.literal: The appraisal says: Formerly, when the Wei house lost control of the reins, the Central Plain was scattered and torn apart.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The appraisal says: In former days, when the Wei house lost its hold on the reins of rule, the Central Plain fell into chaos and dissolution.

manualTranslations.zh: 齊神武爰從晉部，大號冀方。
manualTranslations.literal: Shenwu of Qi then arose from the Jin region and raised his great banner in the lands of Ji.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Shenwu of Qi rose from the Jin region and proclaimed his cause across Ji.

manualTranslations.zh: 屢戰而翦凶徒，一麾以清京洛。
manualTranslations.literal: Through repeated battles he cut down the wicked bands; with one wave of command he cleared the capital and Luoyang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Battle after battle he destroyed the rebel bands, and with a single command he cleared the capital and Luoyang.

manualTranslations.zh: 尊主匡國，功濟天下。
manualTranslations.literal: He honored the ruler and set the state upright; his achievement aided all under Heaven.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He honored the sovereign, upheld the state, and by his achievement brought aid to the realm.

manualTranslations.zh: 既而魏武帝規避權逼，歷數既盡，適所以速關、河之分焉。
manualTranslations.literal: Afterward Emperor Wu of Wei planned to avoid the pressure of authority; since the allotted cycle was already exhausted, this was precisely what hastened the division between the Passes and the River.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Later, Emperor Wu of Wei sought to evade the pressure of overmighty power. With the dynastic mandate already spent, that only hastened the division between the Guanzhong and Yellow River regions.

sourceRange.text: 」五年正月朔，日蝕，神武曰：「日蝕其為我耶，死亦何恨。」丙午，陳啟於魏帝。是日，崩於晉陽，時年五十二，秘不發喪。六月壬午，魏帝於東堂舉哀，三日，制緦衰。詔凶禮依漢大將軍霍光、東平王蒼故事；贈假黃鉞、使持節、相國、都督中外諸軍事、齊王璽紱，轀輬車、黃屋、左纛、前後羽葆、鼓吹、輕車、介士，兼備九錫殊禮，諡獻武王。八月甲申，葬於鄴西北漳水之西，魏帝臨送於紫陌。天保初，追崇為獻武帝，廟號太祖，陵曰義平。改諡神武皇帝，廟號高祖。

context.beforeSource: 少堪敵侯景者唯有慕容紹宗，我故不貴之，留以與汝，宜深加殊禮，委以經略。
context.afterSource: 神武性深密高岸，終日儼然，人不能測。

manualTranslations.zh: 五年正月朔，日蝕，神武曰：「日蝕其為我耶，死亦何恨。」
manualTranslations.literal: On the first day of the first month of the fifth year, the sun was eclipsed. Shenwu said, "If the eclipse is perhaps for me, even death would leave no regret."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On New Year's day of the fifth year, the sun was eclipsed. Shenwu said, "If the eclipse is for me, I would have no regret in dying."

manualTranslations.zh: 丙午，陳啟於魏帝。
manualTranslations.literal: On bingwu he submitted a report to the Wei emperor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On bingwu he sent a report to the Wei emperor.

manualTranslations.zh: 是日，崩於晉陽，時年五十二，秘不發喪。
manualTranslations.literal: That day he died at Jinyang, aged fifty-two, and the death was kept secret and not announced.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That day he died at Jinyang, aged fifty-two; his death was kept secret and no mourning was announced.

manualTranslations.zh: 六月壬午，魏帝於東堂舉哀，三日，制緦衰。
manualTranslations.literal: On renwu in the sixth month, the Wei emperor held mourning in the Eastern Hall for three days and ordered the fine-hemp mourning dress.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On renwu in the sixth month, the Wei emperor mourned him for three days in the Eastern Hall and ordered the prescribed hemp mourning.

manualTranslations.zh: 詔凶禮依漢大將軍霍光、東平王蒼故事；
manualTranslations.literal: An edict ordered that the funeral rites follow the precedents of Han Grand General Huo Guang and King Cang of Dongping;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: An edict ordered that the funeral rites follow the precedents of Huo Guang, Grand General of Han, and King Cang of Dongping;

manualTranslations.zh: 贈假黃鉞、使持節、相國、都督中外諸軍事、齊王璽紱，轀輬車、黃屋、左纛、前後羽葆、鼓吹、輕車、介士，兼備九錫殊禮，諡獻武王。
manualTranslations.literal: He was posthumously granted the acting Yellow Axe, envoy with credentials, Chancellor, commander-in-chief of all armies within and without, the seal and cord of the King of Qi, a funeral carriage, yellow canopy, left standard, feathered canopies and music before and behind, light carriages and armored guards, with the special rites of the Nine Bestowals complete; his posthumous title was King Xianwu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was posthumously granted the acting Yellow Axe, envoy credentials, the chancellorship, command of all armies within and without, the seal and cord of the King of Qi, a funeral carriage, yellow canopy, left standard, front and rear feathered canopies, ceremonial music, light carriages, armored guards, and the full special rites of the Nine Bestowals. His posthumous title was King Xianwu.

manualTranslations.zh: 八月甲申，葬於鄴西北漳水之西，魏帝臨送於紫陌。
manualTranslations.literal: On jiashen in the eighth month, he was buried northwest of Ye, west of the Zhang River, and the Wei emperor personally attended the send-off at Zimo.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On jiashen in the eighth month, he was buried northwest of Ye, west of the Zhang River; the Wei emperor personally saw him off at Zimo.

manualTranslations.zh: 天保初，追崇為獻武帝，廟號太祖，陵曰義平。
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of Tianbao he was posthumously exalted as Emperor Xianwu, with temple name Taizu, and his mausoleum was called Yiping.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Tianbao he was posthumously honored as Emperor Xianwu, with the temple name Taizu; his mausoleum was named Yiping.

manualTranslations.zh: 改諡神武皇帝，廟號高祖。
manualTranslations.literal: His posthumous title was changed to Emperor Shenwu, and his temple name was Gaozu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His posthumous title was later changed to Emperor Shenwu, with the temple name Gaozu.

sourceRange.text: 」論曰：文襄嗣膺霸道，威略昭著。內除奸逆，外拓淮夷，擯斥貪殘，存情人物。而志在峻法，急於禦下，於前王之德，有所未同。蓋天意人心，好生惡殺，雖吉凶報應，未皆影響。總而論之，積善多慶。然文襄之禍生所忽，蓋有由焉。

manualTranslations.zh: 論曰：文襄嗣膺霸道，威略昭著。
manualTranslations.literal: The appraisal says: Wenxiang succeeded to the hegemonic enterprise, and his martial strategy was plainly displayed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The appraisal says: Wenxiang inherited the hegemonic enterprise, and his power and strategy were unmistakable.

manualTranslations.zh: 內除奸逆，外拓淮夷，擯斥貪殘，存情人物。
manualTranslations.literal: Within he removed traitors and rebels; without he expanded against the Huai barbarians; he cast out the greedy and cruel, and kept concern for men of worth.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At home he eliminated treacherous rebels; abroad he pushed back the Huai peoples. He drove out the greedy and cruel, and showed concern for capable men.

manualTranslations.zh: 而志在峻法，急於禦下，於前王之德，有所未同。
manualTranslations.literal: Yet his intent lay in severe laws and he was harsh in governing subordinates; in the virtue of the former king, there was something with which he did not accord.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yet he set his mind on harsh law and was impatient in ruling those below him; in this he fell short of the former king's virtue.

manualTranslations.zh: 蓋天意人心，好生惡殺，雖吉凶報應，未皆影響。
manualTranslations.literal: For Heaven's intent and human feeling love life and hate killing; although good and ill fortune answer deeds, they do not always follow like echo and shadow.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Heaven's will and human feeling cherish life and abhor killing. Although fortune and disaster answer conduct, they do not always follow as swiftly as echo and shadow.

manualTranslations.zh: 總而論之，積善多慶。
manualTranslations.literal: To sum it up, accumulated goodness brings many blessings.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In sum, accumulated goodness brings abundant blessing.

manualTranslations.zh: 然文襄之禍生所忽，蓋有由焉。
manualTranslations.literal: Yet Wenxiang's disaster arose from what he neglected; there was surely a cause for it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yet Wenxiang's disaster grew out of what he neglected; it had its cause.

localRange.text: 戊午，乃即皇帝位於南郊，升壇柴燎告天曰：皇帝臣洋敢用玄牡，昭告於皇皇后帝：否泰相沿，廢興迭用，至道無親，應運斯輔。上覽唐、虞，下稽魏、晉，莫不先天揖讓，考歷終歸。魏氏多難，年將三十，孝昌已後，內外去之。世道橫流，蒼生塗炭。賴我獻武，拯其將溺，三建元首，再立宗祧，掃絕羣凶，芟夷奸宄。德被黔黎，勳光宇宙。文襄嗣武，克構鴻基，功浹寰宇，威陵海外，窮髮懷音，西寇納款，青丘保候，丹穴來庭，扶翼危機，重匡頹運，是則有大造於魏室也。魏帝以卜世告終，上靈厭德，欽若昊天，允歸大命，以禪於臣洋。夫四海至公，天下為一，總民宰世，樹之以君，既川嶽啟符，人神效祉，群公卿士，八方兆庶，僉曰皇極乃顧於上，魏朝推進於下，天位不可以暫虛。遂逼群議，恭膺大典。猥以寡薄，托於兆民之上，雖天威在顏，咫尺無遠，循躬自省，實懷祗惕。敬簡元辰，升壇受禪，肆類上帝，以答萬國之心，永隆嘉祉，保祐有齊，以被於無窮之祚。是日，京師獲赤雀，獻於南郊。

sourceRange.text: 魏帝遣兼太尉彭城王韶、司空潘相樂冊命曰：魏帝以天人之望有歸，丙辰，下詔曰：又使兼太尉彭城王韶、兼司空敬顯儁奉冊曰：又致璽書於帝，遣兼太保彭城王韶、兼司空敬顯儁奉皇帝璽綬，禪代之禮一依唐虞、漢魏故事。

localRange.text: 魏帝遣兼太尉彭城王韶、司空潘相樂冊命曰：於戲！敬聽朕命：夫惟天為大，列晷宿而垂象；謂地蓋厚，疏川嶽以阜物。所以四時代序，萬類駢羅，庶品得性，群形不夭。然則皇王統曆，深視高居，拱默垂衣，寄成師相，此則夏伯、殷尹竭其股肱，周成、漢昭無為而治。頃者天下多難，國命如旒，則我建國之業將墜於地。齊獻武王奮迅風雲，大濟艱危，爰翼朕躬，國為再造，經營庶土，以至勤憂。及文襄承構，愈廣前業，康邦夷難，道格穹蒼。王縱德應期，千齡一出，惟幾惟深，乃神乃聖，大崇霸德，實廣相猷。雖冥功妙實，藐絕言象，標聲示迹，典禮宜宣。今申後命，其敬虛受。王摶風初舉，建旟上地，庇民立政，時雨滂流，下識廉恥，仁加水陸，移風易俗，自齊變魯，此王之功也。仍攝天臺，總參戎律，策出若神，威行朔土，引弓竄跡，松塞無煙，此又王之功也。逮光統前緒，持衡匡合，華戎混一，風海調夷，日月光華，天地清晏，聲接響隨，無思不偃，此又王之功也。逖矣炎方，逋違正朔，懷文曜武，授略申規，淮楚連城，漼然桑落，此又王之功也。關、峴衿帶，跨躡蕭條，腸胃之地，嶽立鴟跱，偏師才指，渙同冰散，此又王之功也。晉熙之所，險薄江雷，迥隔聲教，迷方未改，命將鞠旅，覆其巢穴，威略風騰，傾懾南海，此又王之功也。群蠻跋扈，世絕南疆，搖盪邊垂，亟為塵梗，懷德畏威，向風請順，傾陬盡落，其至如雲，此又王之功也。胡人別種，延蔓山谷，酋渠萬族，廣袤千里，憑險不恭，恣其桀黠，有樂淳風，相攜叩款，粟帛之調，王府充積，此又王之功也。茫茫涉海，世敵諸華，風行鳥逝，倏來忽往，既飲醇醪，附同膠漆，毛裘委仞，奇獸銜尾，此又王之功也。秦川尚阻，作我仇讎，爰挹椒蘭，飛書請好，天動其衷，辭卑禮厚，區宇乂甯，遐邇畢至，此又王之功也。江陰告禍，民無適歸，蕭宗子弟，尚相投庇，如鳥還山，猶川赴海，荊江十部，俄而獻割，乘此會也，將混朱方，此又王之功也。天平地成，率土咸茂，禎符顯見，史不停筆，既連百木，兼呈九尾，素過秦雀，蒼比周烏，此又王之功也。搜揚管庫，衣冠獲序，禮云樂云，銷沉俱振，輕徭徹賦，矜獄寬刑，大信外彰，深仁遠洽，此又王之功也。王有安日下之大勳，加以表光明之盛德，宣贊洪猷，以左右朕言。昔旦、奭外分，毛、畢入佐，出內之任，王宜總之。人謀鬼謀，兩儀協契，錫命之行，義申公道。以王踐律蹈禮，軌物蒼生，圓首安志，率心歸道，是以錫王大路、戎路各一，玄牡二駟。王深重民天，唯本是務，衣食之用，榮辱所由，是用錫王袞冕之服，赤舄副焉。王深廣惠和，易調風化，神祗且格，功德可象，是用錫王軒懸之樂，六佾之舞。王風聲振赫，九域咸綏，遠人率俾，奔走委贐，是用錫王朱戶以居。王求賢選衆，草萊以盡，陳力就列，罔非其人，是用錫王納陛以登。王英圖猛概，抑揚千品，毅然之節，肅是非違，是用錫王武賁之士三百人。王興亡所繫，制極幽顯，糾行天討，罪人咸得，是用錫王鈇鉞各一。王鷹揚豹變，實扶下土，狼顧鴟張，罔不彈射，是用錫王彤弓一、彤矢百、盧弓十、盧矢千。王孝悌之至，通於神明，率民興行，感達區宇，是用錫王秬鬯一卣，珪瓚副焉。往欽哉。其祗順往冊，保弼皇家，用終爾休德，對揚我太祖之顯命。魏帝以天人之望有歸，丙辰，下詔曰：三才剖判，百王代興，治天靜地，和神敬鬼，庇民造物，咸自靈符，非一人之大寶，實有道之神器。昔我宗祖應運，奄一區宇，歷聖重光，暨于九葉。德之不嗣，仍離屯圮，盜名字者遍於九服，擅制命者非止三公，主殺朝危，人神靡繫，天下之大，將非魏有。賴齊獻武王奮揚靈武，克剪多難，重懸日月，更綴參辰，廟以掃除，國由再造，鴻勳巨業，無德而稱。逮文襄承構，世業逾廣，邇安遠服，海內晏如，國命已康，生生得性。迄相國齊王，緯文經武，統茲大業，盡睿窮幾，研深測化，思隨冥運，智與神行，恩比春天，威同夏日，坦至心於萬物，被大道於八方，故百僚師師，朝無秕政，網疏澤洽，率土歸心。外盡江淮，風靡屈膝，辟地懷人，百城奔走，關隴慕義而請好，瀚漠仰德而致誠。伊所謂命世應期，實撫千載。禎符雜遝，異物同途，謳頌填委，殊方一致，代終之迹斯表，人靈之契已合，天道不遠，我不獨知。朕入纂鴻休，將承世祀，籍援立之厚，延宗社之算，靜言大運，欣於避賢，遠惟唐、虞禪代之典，近想魏、晉揖讓之風，其可昧興替之禮，稽神祇之望？今便遜於別宮，歸帝位於齊國，推聖與能，眇符前軌。主者宣佈天下，以時施行。又使兼太尉彭城王韶、兼司空敬顯儁奉冊曰：咨爾相國齊王：夫氣分形化，物繫君長，皇王遞興，人非一姓。昔放勳馭世，沉璧屬子；重華握曆，持衡擁璇。所以英賢茂實，昭晰千古，豈盛衰有運，興廢在時，知命不得不授，畏天不可不受。是故漢劉告否，當塗順民，曹歷不永，金行納禪，此皆重規襲矩，率由舊章者也。我祖宗光宅，混一萬宇。迄於正光之末，奸孽乘權，厥政多僻，九域離蕩。永安運窮，人靈殄瘁，羣逆滔天，割裂四海，國土臣民，行非魏有。齊獻武王應期授手，鳳舉龍驤，舉廢極以立天，扶傾柱而鎮地，剪滅黎毒，匡我墜曆，有大德於魏室，被博利於蒼生。及文襄繼軌，誕光前業，內剿凶權，外摧侵叛，遐邇肅晏，功格上玄。王神祇協德，舟梁一世，體文昭武，追變窮微。自舉跡藩旟，頌歌總集，入統機衡，風猷弘遠。及大承世業，扶國昌家，相德日躋，霸風愈邈，威靈斯暢則荒遠賓士，聲略所播而鄰敵順款。以富有之資，運英特之氣，顧盻之間，無思不服。圖諜潛蘊，千祀彰明，嘉禎幽秘，一朝紛委，以表代德之期，用啟興邦之迹，蒼蒼在上，照臨不遠。朕以虛昧，猶未逡巡，靜言愧之，坐而待旦。且時來運往，媯舜不暇以當陽，世革命改，伯禹不容于北面，況於寡薄，而可踟躕。是以仰協穹昊，俯從百姓，敬以帝位式授於王。天祿永終，大命格矣。於戲！其祗承曆數，允執其中，對揚天休，斯年千萬，豈不盛歟！又致璽書於帝，遣兼太保彭城王韶、兼司空敬顯儁奉皇帝璽綬，禪代之禮一依唐虞、漢魏故事。

sourceRange.text: 是歲，周武成元年。乾明元年庚辰，春正月癸丑朔，改元。己未，詔寬徭賦。癸亥，高陽王湜薨。是月，車駕至自晉陽。二月己亥，以太傅、常山王演爲太師、錄尚書事，以太尉、長廣王湛爲大司馬、幷省錄尚書事，以尚書左僕射、平秦王歸彥爲司空，趙郡王叡爲尚書左僕射。詔諸元良口配沒宮內及賜人者，並放免。甲辰，帝幸芳林園，親錄囚徒，死罪以下降免各有差。

manualTranslations.zh: 二月己亥，以太傅、常山王演爲太師、錄尚書事，以太尉、長廣王湛爲大司馬、幷省錄尚書事，以尚書左僕射、平秦王歸彥爲司空，趙郡王叡爲尚書左僕射。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second month, on jihai, the Grand Tutor, Prince Yan of Changshan, was made Grand Preceptor and Recorder of the Affairs of the Masters of Writing; the Grand Commandant, Prince Zhan of Changguang, was made Grand Marshal and Recorder of the Affairs of the Masters of Writing in Bing Province; the Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, Prince Guiyan of Pingqin, was made Minister of Works; and Prince Rui of Zhaojun was made Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second month, on jihai, Prince Yan of Changshan, then grand tutor, was appointed grand preceptor and recorder of the Masters of Writing. Prince Zhan of Changguang, then grand commandant, became grand marshal and recorder of the Masters of Writing in the Bingzhou administration. Prince Guiyan of Pingqin, left vice director of the Masters of Writing, became minister of works, and Prince Rui of Zhaojun became left vice director.

manualTranslations.zh: 甲辰，帝幸芳林園，親錄囚徒，死罪以下降免各有差。
manualTranslations.literal: On jiachen, the emperor visited Fanglin Garden and personally reviewed the prisoners; those sentenced to death and below received reductions or exemptions, each by degree.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On jiachen, the emperor visited Fanglin Garden and personally reviewed the prisoners. Sentences at the death penalty and below were reduced or remitted by graded degrees.

sourceRange.text: 皇建二年九月，殂於晉陽，年十七。帝聰慧夙成，寬厚仁智，天保間雅有令名。及承大位，楊愔、燕子獻、宋欽道等同輔。以常山王地親望重，內外畏服，加以文宣初崩之日，太后本欲立之，故愔等並懷猜忌。常山王憂悵，乃白太后誅其黨，時平秦王歸彥亦預謀焉。皇建二年秋，天文告變，歸彥慮有後害，仍白孝昭，以王當咎。乃遣歸彥馳驛至晉陽宮殺之。王薨後，孝昭不豫，見文宣爲祟。孝昭深惡之，厭勝術備設而無益也。薨三旬而孝昭崩。大寧二年，葬於武寧之西北，諡閔悼王。初，文宣命邢卲制帝名殷，字正道，帝從而尤之曰：「殷家弟及，『正』字一止，吾身後兒不得也。」卲懼，請改焉。文宣不許曰：「天也。」因謂孝昭帝曰：「奪但奪，慎勿殺也。」論曰：濟南繼業，大革其弊，風教粲然，搢紳稱幸。股肱輔弼，雖懷厥誠，旣不能贊弘道德，和睦親懿，又不能遠慮防身，深謀衛主，應斷不斷，自取其咎。臣旣誅夷，君壽廢辱，皆任非其器之所致爾。

manualTranslations.zh: 皇建二年九月，殂於晉陽，年十七。
manualTranslations.literal: In the ninth month of the second year of Huangjian he died at Jinyang, aged seventeen.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the second year of the Huangjian era he died at Jinyang, at the age of seventeen.

manualTranslations.zh: 帝聰慧夙成，寬厚仁智，天保間雅有令名。
manualTranslations.literal: The emperor was intelligent and wise from an early age, generous, kind, benevolent, and discerning; during Tianbao he had a fine reputation.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The emperor showed intelligence early, was generous and humane, and during the Tianbao era enjoyed an excellent reputation.

manualTranslations.zh: 及承大位，楊愔、燕子獻、宋欽道等同輔。
manualTranslations.literal: When he inherited the great throne, Yang Yin, Yanzi Xian, Song Qindao, and others assisted him together.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When he came to the throne, Yang Yin, Yanzi Xian, Song Qindao, and others served jointly as his advisers.

manualTranslations.zh: 以常山王地親望重，內外畏服，加以文宣初崩之日，太后本欲立之，故愔等並懷猜忌。
manualTranslations.literal: Because the Prince of Changshan was close in kinship and weighty in reputation, and those within and without feared and submitted to him, and because on the day Emperor Wenxuan first died the empress dowager had originally wanted to enthrone him, Yin and the others all harbored suspicion.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Prince Yan of Changshan was a close kinsman with formidable prestige, feared and obeyed at court and beyond. Since the empress dowager had originally wanted to enthrone him when Emperor Wenxuan died, Yang Yin and the others all suspected him.

manualTranslations.zh: 常山王憂悵，乃白太后誅其黨，時平秦王歸彥亦預謀焉。
manualTranslations.literal: The Prince of Changshan became anxious and distressed, and so reported to the empress dowager that their party should be executed; at the time Prince Guiyan of Pingqin also took part in the plot.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Prince Yan of Changshan grew anxious and asked the empress dowager to execute that faction; Prince Guiyan of Pingqin was also involved in the plot.

manualTranslations.zh: 皇建二年秋，天文告變，歸彥慮有後害，仍白孝昭，以王當咎。
manualTranslations.literal: In autumn of the second year of Huangjian, celestial signs announced change; Guiyan feared there would be later danger, and again told Xiaozhao that the prince was the one on whom blame would fall.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In autumn of Huangjian 2, ominous celestial signs appeared. Guiyan feared future trouble and again told Emperor Xiaozhao that the prince was the one portended by the omen.

manualTranslations.zh: 乃遣歸彥馳驛至晉陽宮殺之。
manualTranslations.literal: He therefore sent Guiyan by relay horse to Jinyang Palace to kill him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He therefore sent Guiyan by relay post to Jinyang Palace to kill him.

manualTranslations.zh: 王薨後，孝昭不豫，見文宣爲祟。
manualTranslations.literal: After the prince died, Xiaozhao fell ill and saw Wenxuan acting as a baleful spirit.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After the prince died, Emperor Xiaozhao fell ill and saw Emperor Wenxuan haunting him as an angry spirit.

manualTranslations.zh: 孝昭深惡之，厭勝術備設而無益也。
manualTranslations.literal: Xiaozhao deeply hated it, and suppressive apotropaic rites were set up in every form, but they were of no benefit.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Xiaozhao was terrified and deployed every rite for suppressing baleful influence, but none helped.

manualTranslations.zh: 薨三旬而孝昭崩。
manualTranslations.literal: Thirty days after the prince died, Xiaozhao died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Thirty days after the prince died, Emperor Xiaozhao died as well.

manualTranslations.zh: 大寧二年，葬於武寧之西北，諡閔悼王。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year of Daning he was buried northwest of Wuning and was posthumously titled Prince Mindao.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Daning 2 he was buried northwest of Wuning and given the posthumous title Prince Mindao.

manualTranslations.zh: 初，文宣命邢卲制帝名殷，字正道，帝從而尤之曰：「殷家弟及，『正』字一止，吾身後兒不得也。」
manualTranslations.literal: Initially, Emperor Wenxuan ordered Xing Shao to devise the emperor's personal name Yin and style Zhengdao; the emperor then faulted him, saying, "In the house of Yin, younger brothers succeeded; the character zheng contains one stop, so after I am gone my son will not get it."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Earlier, Emperor Wenxuan had ordered Xing Shao to devise Yin as the emperor's personal name and Zhengdao as his style. Wenxuan later faulted him for it: "In the house of Yin, brothers succeeded one another, and the character 正 contains a single 'stop.' After I am gone, my son will not have it."

manualTranslations.zh: 卲懼，請改焉。
manualTranslations.literal: Shao was afraid and asked to change it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Shao was frightened and asked to change the names.

manualTranslations.zh: 文宣不許曰：「天也。」
manualTranslations.literal: Wenxuan did not permit it and said, "It is Heaven."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Wenxuan refused, saying, "It is Heaven."

manualTranslations.zh: 因謂孝昭帝曰：「奪但奪，慎勿殺也。」
manualTranslations.literal: He then told Emperor Xiaozhao, "If you seize it, just seize it; be careful not to kill him."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He then told Emperor Xiaozhao, "If you take it, take it, but be careful not to kill him."

manualTranslations.zh: 論曰：濟南繼業，大革其弊，風教粲然，搢紳稱幸。
manualTranslations.literal: The appraisal says: Jinan inherited the enterprise, greatly reformed its abuses, and teaching and customs shone brightly; the gentry considered themselves fortunate.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The appraisal says: Jinan inherited the enterprise and greatly reformed its abuses. Teaching and custom shone brightly, and the gentry counted themselves fortunate.

manualTranslations.zh: 股肱輔弼，雖懷厥誠，旣不能贊弘道德，和睦親懿，又不能遠慮防身，深謀衛主，應斷不斷，自取其咎。
manualTranslations.literal: His chief ministers and assistants, although they held sincere intentions, could neither assist him in magnifying the Way and virtue and harmonizing his close kin, nor plan farsightedly to protect themselves and deeply scheme to safeguard their lord; when they should have acted decisively they did not, and brought blame upon themselves.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His chief ministers may have been sincere, but they could not help him enlarge the Way and virtue or keep harmony among his kin. Nor could they plan far enough to protect themselves or safeguard their lord. When decision was needed they failed to decide, and brought disaster on themselves.

manualTranslations.zh: 臣旣誅夷，君壽廢辱，皆任非其器之所致爾。
manualTranslations.literal: The ministers were already executed and wiped out, while the ruler, though alive, was deposed and humiliated; all this came from entrusting office to men who were not equal to the task.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The ministers were exterminated, and the ruler, though still alive, was deposed and humiliated. All of it came from entrusting affairs to men unequal to the task.

sourceRange.text: 十一月甲辰，詔曰：「朕嬰此暴疾，奄忽無逮。今嗣子沖眇，未閑政術，社稷業重，理歸上德。右丞相、長廣王湛研機測化，體道居宗，人雄之望，海內瞻仰，同胞共氣，家國所憑，可遣尚書左僕射、趙郡王叡喻旨，征王統茲大寶。其喪紀之禮一同漢文，三十六日悉從公除，山陵施用，務從儉約。」先是帝不豫而無闕聽覽，是月，崩於晉陽宮，時年二十七。大寧元年閏十二月癸卯，梓宮還鄴，上諡曰孝昭皇帝。庚午，葬於文靖陵。

context.beforeSource: 己酉，野雉棲于前殿之庭。
context.afterSource: 帝聰敏有識度，深沉能斷，不可窺測。

manualTranslations.zh: 十一月甲辰，詔曰：「朕嬰此暴疾，奄忽無逮。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eleventh month, on jiachen, an edict said: "I have been stricken by this violent illness and suddenly can no longer reach affairs.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on jiachen, an edict declared, "I have been struck by a sudden grave illness and can no longer attend to affairs.

manualTranslations.zh: 今嗣子沖眇，未閑政術，社稷業重，理歸上德。
manualTranslations.literal: Now the heir is young and slight, not yet practiced in the arts of government; the work of the altars of soil and grain is weighty, and by principle it returns to one of highest virtue.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The heir is young and slight, not yet versed in statecraft. The charge of the dynasty is heavy, and by rights it should pass to one of highest virtue.

manualTranslations.zh: 右丞相、長廣王湛研機測化，體道居宗，人雄之望，海內瞻仰，同胞共氣，家國所憑，可遣尚書左僕射、趙郡王叡喻旨，征王統茲大寶。
manualTranslations.literal: The Right Chancellor, Prince Zhan of Changguang, studies subtle workings and fathoms transformation, embodies the Way and stands within the clan; as a hero among men, he is looked up to within the seas. Of the same womb and shared breath, he is one on whom house and state rely. The Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, Prince Rui of Zhaojun, may be sent to explain the intent and summon the prince to govern this great treasure.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Prince Zhan of Changguang, right chancellor, understands hidden workings and change, embodies the Way, and stands foremost among the clan. The whole realm looks to him as a hero among men. Born of the same mother and sharing the same breath, he is the support of house and state. Send Prince Rui of Zhaojun, left vice director of the Masters of Writing, to convey my intent and summon him to take charge of the throne.

manualTranslations.zh: 其喪紀之禮一同漢文，三十六日悉從公除，山陵施用，務從儉約。」
manualTranslations.literal: As for the rites of mourning, let all be the same as under Emperor Wen of Han; after thirty-six days, all shall follow public removal of mourning, and the expenditures for the mountain mausoleum must follow frugality."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: As for mourning rites, follow entirely the precedent of Emperor Wen of Han. After thirty-six days all mourning shall be removed according to public rule, and the mausoleum expenses must be kept frugal."

manualTranslations.zh: 先是帝不豫而無闕聽覽，是月，崩於晉陽宮，時年二十七。
manualTranslations.literal: Before this, the emperor had been ill but had not neglected hearings and review; that month he died in Jinyang Palace, aged twenty-seven.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Before this the emperor had been ill, yet he had not neglected audiences or reviews of affairs. That month he died in Jinyang Palace at the age of twenty-seven.

manualTranslations.zh: 大寧元年閏十二月癸卯，梓宮還鄴，上諡曰孝昭皇帝。
manualTranslations.literal: In the intercalary twelfth month of the first year of Daning, on guimao, the imperial coffin returned to Ye, and the posthumous title Emperor Xiaozhao was presented.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the intercalary twelfth month of Daning 1, on guimao, his coffin was returned to Ye, and he was given the posthumous title Emperor Xiaozhao.

manualTranslations.zh: 庚午，葬於文靖陵。
manualTranslations.literal: On gengwu, he was buried in Wenjing Mausoleum.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On gengwu he was buried in Wenjing Mausoleum.

sourceRange.text: 及文宣崩，帝居禁中護喪事，幼主即位，乃即朝班。除太傅、錄尚書，朝政皆決於帝。月餘，乃居藩邸，自是詔勑多不關帝。客或言於帝曰：「鷙烏舍巢，必有探卵之患，今日之地，何宜屢出。」乾明元年，從廢帝赴鄴，居於領軍府。時楊愔、燕子獻、可朱渾天和、宋欽道、鄭子默等以帝威望旣重，內懼權逼，請以帝為太師、司州牧、錄尚書事；長廣王湛為大司馬、錄幷省尚書事，解京畿大都督。帝時以尊親而見猜斥，乃與長廣王期獵，謀之於野。

context.beforeSource: 帝月餘漸瘳，不敢復諫。
context.afterSource: 三月甲戌，帝初上省，旦發領軍府，大風暴起，壞所御車幔，帝甚惡之。

manualTranslations.zh: 及文宣崩，帝居禁中護喪事，幼主即位，乃即朝班。
manualTranslations.literal: When Wenxuan died, the emperor remained inside the palace to oversee the funeral arrangements; after the young ruler ascended the throne, he then took his place in the court ranks.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Wenxuan died, Xiaozhao remained in the palace to oversee the funeral. Once the young ruler took the throne, he entered the court ranks.

manualTranslations.zh: 除太傅、錄尚書，朝政皆決於帝。
manualTranslations.literal: He was appointed Grand Tutor and Recorder of the Masters of Writing, and all court government was decided by the emperor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was appointed grand tutor and recorder of the Masters of Writing, and all court affairs were decided by him.

manualTranslations.zh: 月餘，乃居藩邸，自是詔勑多不關帝。
manualTranslations.literal: After more than a month he went to live in his princely residence, and from then on edicts and commands often did not involve the emperor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After a little over a month he withdrew to his princely residence, and from then on many edicts no longer passed through him.

manualTranslations.zh: 客或言於帝曰：「鷙烏舍巢，必有探卵之患，今日之地，何宜屢出。」
manualTranslations.literal: A guest once said to the emperor, "When a fierce bird leaves its nest, there is sure to be the danger of someone probing its eggs; in your present position, you should not go out repeatedly."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: One guest warned him, "When a bird of prey leaves the nest, someone is bound to reach for its eggs. In your present position, you should not be going out so often."

manualTranslations.zh: 乾明元年，從廢帝赴鄴，居於領軍府。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Qianming, he followed Emperor Fei to Ye and lived at the headquarters of the Commanding General.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Qianming 1 he accompanied Emperor Fei to Ye and resided at the headquarters of the Commanding General.

manualTranslations.zh: 時楊愔、燕子獻、可朱渾天和、宋欽道、鄭子默等以帝威望旣重，內懼權逼，請以帝為太師、司州牧、錄尚書事；
manualTranslations.literal: At the time Yang Yin, Yanzi Xian, Kezhuhun Tianhe, Song Qindao, Zheng Zimo, and others, because the emperor’s prestige had become weighty and they inwardly feared the pressure of his power, requested that he be made Grand Preceptor, governor of Sizhou, and Recorder of the Masters of Writing;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the time Yang Yin, Yanzi Xian, Kezhuhun Tianhe, Song Qindao, Zheng Zimo, and the others saw how great his prestige had become and secretly feared the pressure of his authority. They asked that he be made grand preceptor, governor of Sizhou, and recorder of the Masters of Writing;

manualTranslations.zh: 長廣王湛為大司馬、錄幷省尚書事，解京畿大都督。
manualTranslations.literal: Prince Zhan of Changguang was made Grand Marshal and Recorder of the Affairs of the Masters of Writing in Bing Province, and was relieved as metropolitan commander of the capital region.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Prince Zhan of Changguang was appointed grand marshal and recorder of the Masters of Writing in the Bingzhou administration, and was relieved of the capital-region command.

manualTranslations.zh: 帝時以尊親而見猜斥，乃與長廣王期獵，謀之於野。
manualTranslations.literal: The emperor at that time, because he was an honored kinsman, was regarded with suspicion and pushed aside; he therefore arranged to hunt with the Prince of Changguang and plotted with him in the countryside.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Because his rank and kinship made him suspect, Xiaozhao was being pushed aside. He therefore arranged a hunt with Prince Zhan of Changguang and plotted with him in the field.

localRange.text: 論曰：神武平定四方，威權在己，遷鄴之後，雖主器有人，號令所加，政皆自出。文宣因循鴻業，內外葉從，自朝及野，群心屬望，東魏之地，舉國樂推，曾未期月，遂登宸極。始則存心政事，風化肅然，數年之間，朝野安出。其後縱酒肆欲，事極倡狂，昏邪殘暴，近代未有，饗國不永，實由斯疾。濟南繼業，大革其弊，風教粲然，搢紳稱幸。股肱輔弼，雖懷厥誠，旣不能贊弘道德，和睦親懿，又不能遠慮防身，深謀衛主，應斷不斷，自取其咎。臣旣誅夷，君壽廢辱，皆任非其器之所致爾。孝昭早居臺閤，故事通明，人吏之間，無所不委。

sourceRange.text: 大寧元年冬十一月癸丑，皇帝即位於南宮，大赦，改皇建二年為大寧。乙卯，以司徒、平秦王歸彥為太傅，以尚書右僕射、趙郡王叡為尚書令，以太尉尉粲為太保，以尚書令段韶為大司馬，以豐州刺史婁叡為司空，乙太傅、平陽王淹為太宰，以太保、彭城王浟為太師、錄尚書事，以冀州刺史、博陵王濟為太尉，以中書監、任城王潛為尚書左僕射，以幷州刺史斛律光為右僕射，封孝昭皇帝太子百年為樂陵郡王。庚申，詔大使巡行天下，求政善惡，問人疾苦，擢進賢良。是歲，周武帝保定元年。河清元年春正月乙亥，車駕至自晉陽。辛巳，祀南郊。壬午，享太廟。丙戌，立妃胡氏為皇后，子緯為皇太子。大赦，內外百官普加汎級，諸為父後者賜爵一級。己亥，以前定州刺史、馮翊王潤為尚書左僕射。詔斷屠殺以順春令。

context.beforeSource: 皇太后令所司宣遺詔，左丞相斛律金率百僚敦勸，三奏，乃許之。
context.afterSource: 二月丁未，乙太宰、平陽王淹為青州刺史、太傅、領司徒，以領軍大將軍、宗師、平秦王歸彥為太宰、冀州刺史。
context.beforeLocal: 皇太后令所司宣遺詔，左丞相斛律金率百僚敦勸，三奏，乃許之。
context.afterLocal: 二月丁未，乙太宰、平陽王淹為青州刺史、太傅、領司徒，以領軍大將軍、宗師、平秦王歸彥為太宰、冀州刺史。

manualTranslations.zh: 大寧元年冬十一月癸丑，皇帝即位於南宮，大赦，改皇建二年為大寧。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Daning, in winter, in the eleventh month, on the guichou day, the emperor ascended the throne in the Southern Palace, issued a general amnesty, and changed the second year of Huangjian to Daning.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In winter, in the eleventh month of the first year of Daning, on guichou, the emperor took the throne in the Southern Palace, proclaimed a general amnesty, and renamed the second year of Huangjian as Daning.

manualTranslations.zh: 乙卯，以司徒、平秦王歸彥為太傅，以尚書右僕射、趙郡王叡為尚書令，以太尉尉粲為太保，以尚書令段韶為大司馬，以豐州刺史婁叡為司空，乙太傅、平陽王淹為太宰，以太保、彭城王浟為太師、錄尚書事，以冀州刺史、博陵王濟為太尉，以中書監、任城王潛為尚書左僕射，以幷州刺史斛律光為右僕射，封孝昭皇帝太子百年為樂陵郡王。
manualTranslations.literal: On the yimao day, Minister over the Masses and Prince Guiyan of Pingqin was made Grand Tutor; Right Vice Director of the Secretariat and Prince Rui of Zhao Commandery was made Chief Minister of the Secretariat; Grand Commandant Wei Can was made Grand Guardian; Chief Minister of the Secretariat Duan Shao was made Grand Marshal; Inspector of Feng Province Lou Rui was made Minister of Works; Grand Tutor and Prince Yan of Pingyang was made Grand Minister; Grand Guardian and Prince You of Pengcheng was made Grand Preceptor and Recorder of the Affairs of the Secretariat; Inspector of Ji Province and Prince Ji of Boling was made Grand Commandant; Director of the Secretariat and Prince Qian of Rencheng was made Left Vice Director of the Secretariat; Inspector of Bing Province Hulu Guang was made Right Vice Director of the Secretariat; and Emperor Xiaozhao's crown prince Bainian was enfeoffed as Prince of Leling Commandery.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the yimao day, the emperor reshuffled the highest offices: Prince Guiyan of Pingqin, Minister over the Masses, became Grand Tutor; Prince Rui of Zhao Commandery, Right Vice Director of the Secretariat, became Chief Minister of the Secretariat; Grand Commandant Wei Can became Grand Guardian; Duan Shao became Grand Marshal; Lou Rui became Minister of Works; Prince Yan of Pingyang became Grand Minister; Prince You of Pengcheng became Grand Preceptor and Recorder of the Affairs of the Secretariat; Prince Ji of Boling became Grand Commandant; Prince Qian of Rencheng became Left Vice Director of the Secretariat; Hulu Guang became Right Vice Director of the Secretariat; and Emperor Xiaozhao's crown prince Bainian was made Prince of Leling Commandery.

manualTranslations.zh: 庚申，詔大使巡行天下，求政善惡，問人疾苦，擢進賢良。
manualTranslations.literal: On the gengshen day, an edict sent senior envoys to tour the realm, seek out what was good and bad in government, ask after the people's hardships, and promote the worthy and capable.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On gengshen, senior envoys were ordered to tour the realm, investigate good and bad government, ask after the people's suffering, and promote worthy talent.

manualTranslations.zh: 是歲，周武帝保定元年。
manualTranslations.literal: That year was the first year of Baoding under Emperor Wu of Zhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That year corresponded to the first year of Baoding under Emperor Wu of Zhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 河清元年春正月乙亥，車駕至自晉陽。
manualTranslations.literal: In spring, in the first month of the first year of Heqing, on the yihai day, the imperial carriage arrived back from Jinyang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In spring, in the first month of the first year of Heqing, on yihai, the emperor returned from Jinyang.

manualTranslations.zh: 辛巳，祀南郊。
manualTranslations.literal: On the xinsi day, he sacrificed at the Southern Suburb.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On xinsi, he performed the sacrifice at the Southern Suburb.

manualTranslations.zh: 壬午，享太廟。
manualTranslations.literal: On the renwu day, he made offerings in the Grand Ancestral Temple.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On renwu, he offered sacrifice in the Grand Ancestral Temple.

manualTranslations.zh: 丙戌，立妃胡氏為皇后，子緯為皇太子。
manualTranslations.literal: On the bingxu day, he established Consort Hu as empress and his son Wei as crown prince.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Consort Hu was made empress and his son Wei was made crown prince.

manualTranslations.zh: 大赦，內外百官普加汎級，諸為父後者賜爵一級。
manualTranslations.literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed; all officials inside and outside the court were broadly advanced in rank, and those serving as their fathers' successors were granted one noble grade.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed. Officials throughout the government were advanced in rank, and heirs carrying on their fathers' lines received one noble grade.

manualTranslations.zh: 己亥，以前定州刺史、馮翊王潤為尚書左僕射。
manualTranslations.literal: On the jihai day, the former Inspector of Ding Province, Prince Run of Fengyi, was made Left Vice Director of the Secretariat.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On jihai, Prince Run of Fengyi, formerly Inspector of Ding Province, was appointed Left Vice Director of the Secretariat.

manualTranslations.zh: 詔斷屠殺以順春令。
manualTranslations.literal: An edict prohibited slaughter in order to accord with the ordinances of spring.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: An edict forbade slaughter, in keeping with the spring ordinances.

sourceRange.text: 十二月乙卯，豫州刺史王士良以城降周將權景宣。丁巳，帝自晉陽南討。己未，太宰、平陽王淹薨。壬戌，太師段韶大破尉遲迥等，解洛陽圍。丁卯，帝至洛陽，免洛州經周軍處一年租賦，赦州城內死罪已下囚。己巳，乙太師段韶為太宰，以司徒斛律光為太尉，幷州刺史蘭陵王長恭為尚書令。壬申，帝至武牢，經滑臺，次於黎陽，所經減降罪人。丙子，車駕至自洛陽。

context.beforeSource: 甲辰，太尉婁叡大破周軍於軹關，擒楊檦。
context.afterSource: 是歲，高麗、靺羯、新羅並遣使朝貢。
context.beforeLocal: 甲辰，太尉婁叡大破周軍於軹關，擒楊檦。
context.afterLocal: 是歲，高麗、靺羯、新羅並遣使朝貢。

manualTranslations.zh: 十二月乙卯，豫州刺史王士良以城降周將權景宣。
manualTranslations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the yimao day, Wang Shiliang, Inspector of Yu Province, surrendered the city to the Zhou general Quan Jingxuan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on yimao, Wang Shiliang, Inspector of Yu Province, surrendered his city to the Zhou general Quan Jingxuan.

manualTranslations.zh: 丁巳，帝自晉陽南討。
manualTranslations.literal: On the dingsi day, the emperor went south from Jinyang to campaign.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On dingsi, the emperor set out south from Jinyang on campaign.

manualTranslations.zh: 己未，太宰、平陽王淹薨。
manualTranslations.literal: On the jiwei day, the Grand Minister, Prince Yan of Pingyang, died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Prince Yan of Pingyang, the Grand Minister, died.

manualTranslations.zh: 壬戌，太師段韶大破尉遲迥等，解洛陽圍。
manualTranslations.literal: On the renxu day, Grand Preceptor Duan Shao badly defeated Yuchi Jiong and the others, lifting the siege of Luoyang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On renxu, Grand Preceptor Duan Shao routed Yuchi Jiong and the others, relieving the siege of Luoyang.

manualTranslations.zh: 丁卯，帝至洛陽，免洛州經周軍處一年租賦，赦州城內死罪已下囚。
manualTranslations.literal: On the dingmao day, the emperor arrived at Luoyang, remitted one year of rents and taxes for the places in Luo Province through which the Zhou army had passed, and pardoned prisoners in the provincial city sentenced to death or below.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On dingmao, the emperor reached Luoyang. He remitted a year of taxes for the parts of Luo Province traversed by the Zhou army and pardoned prisoners in the provincial seat whose sentences were death or less.

manualTranslations.zh: 己巳，乙太師段韶為太宰，以司徒斛律光為太尉，幷州刺史蘭陵王長恭為尚書令。
manualTranslations.literal: On the jisi day, Grand Preceptor Duan Shao was made Grand Minister, Minister over the Masses Hulu Guang was made Grand Commandant, and Prince Changgong of Lanling, Inspector of Bing Province, was made Chief Minister of the Secretariat.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On jisi, Duan Shao was made Grand Minister, Hulu Guang was made Grand Commandant, and Prince Changgong of Lanling, Inspector of Bing Province, was made Chief Minister of the Secretariat.

manualTranslations.zh: 壬申，帝至武牢，經滑臺，次於黎陽，所經減降罪人。
manualTranslations.literal: On the renshen day, the emperor reached Wulao, passed through Huatai, and halted at Liyang; in the places he passed, he reduced the punishments of offenders.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On renshen, the emperor reached Wulao, passed through Huatai, and stopped at Liyang, reducing punishments for offenders along his route.

manualTranslations.zh: 丙子，車駕至自洛陽。
manualTranslations.literal: On the bingzi day, the imperial carriage arrived back from Luoyang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On bingzi, the emperor returned from Luoyang.

sourceRange.text: 論曰：武成風度高爽，經算弘長，文武之官，俱盡其力，有帝王之量矣。但愛狎庸豎，委以朝權，帷薄之間，淫侈過度，滅亡之兆，其在斯乎？玄象告變，傳位元子，名號雖殊，政猶己出，跡有虛飾，事非憲典，聰明臨下，何易可誣。又河南、河間、樂陵等諸王，或以時嫌，或以猜忌，皆無罪而殞，非所謂知命任天道之義也。

context.beforeSource: 五年二月甲申，葬於永平陵。
context.afterSource: 全文以中華書局、一九七二年十一月、第一版《北齊書》為本校。

manualTranslations.zh: 論曰：武成風度高爽，經算弘長，文武之官，俱盡其力，有帝王之量矣。
manualTranslations.literal: The appraisal says: Wucheng's bearing was lofty and expansive, and his plans and calculations were broad and far-reaching; civil and military officials all exerted their full efforts for him, and he had the capacity of an emperor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The appraisal says: Wucheng had an elevated bearing and far-reaching strategic judgment. Civil and military officials alike gave him their full efforts, and he possessed the measure of an emperor.

manualTranslations.zh: 但愛狎庸豎，委以朝權，帷薄之間，淫侈過度，滅亡之兆，其在斯乎？
manualTranslations.literal: Yet he loved and kept close company with mediocre underlings, entrusted them with power at court, and in the inner chambers indulged in licentious extravagance beyond measure; were the signs of destruction not here?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yet he was intimate with base underlings and entrusted them with court power, while within the palace chambers his licentious extravagance exceeded all bounds. The signs of ruin lay precisely there, did they not?

manualTranslations.zh: 玄象告變，傳位元子，名號雖殊，政猶己出，跡有虛飾，事非憲典，聰明臨下，何易可誣。
manualTranslations.literal: The dark celestial signs announced change, and he transmitted the throne to his eldest son; although the title and name were different, government still issued from himself. The act had empty ornament and was not in accord with constitutional precedent; with Heaven's clear intelligence looking down below, how could it easily be deceived?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Celestial signs announced change, so he passed the throne to his eldest son. The title changed, but government still came from him; the act was empty ornament, not proper precedent. With Heaven watching clearly from above, how could it be so easily deceived?

manualTranslations.zh: 又河南、河間、樂陵等諸王，或以時嫌，或以猜忌，皆無罪而殞，非所謂知命任天道之義也。
manualTranslations.literal: Moreover, the princes of Henan, Hejian, Leling, and the others, some because of suspicion at the time and others because of jealous mistrust, all died without guilt; this was not what is meant by knowing the mandate and entrusting oneself to the Way of Heaven.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Moreover, the princes of Henan, Hejian, Leling, and others all died guiltless, some from the suspicions of the moment and some from jealous fear. This was hardly the meaning of knowing the mandate and yielding to the Way of Heaven.

sourceRange.text: 六月乙巳，齊州言濟、河水口見八龍升天。乙卯，詔兼散騎常侍崔子武使于陳。庚申，司州牧、河南王孝瑜薨。

context.beforeSource: 五月壬午，詔以城南雙堂閏位之苑，廻造大總持寺。
context.afterSource: 秋八月辛丑，詔以三臺宮為大興聖寺。
context.beforeLocal: 五月壬午，詔以城南雙堂閏位之苑，廻造大總持寺。
context.afterLocal: 秋八月辛丑，詔以三臺宮為大興聖寺。

manualTranslations.zh: 六月乙巳，齊州言濟、河水口見八龍升天。
manualTranslations.literal: In the sixth month, on the yisi day, Qi Province reported that at the mouths of the Ji and Yellow rivers eight dragons were seen ascending to Heaven.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on yisi, Qi Province reported that eight dragons had been seen ascending to Heaven at the mouths of the Ji and Yellow rivers.

manualTranslations.zh: 乙卯，詔兼散騎常侍崔子武使于陳。
manualTranslations.literal: On the yimao day, an edict ordered Concurrent Cavalier Attendant-in-ordinary Cui Ziwu to go as envoy to Chen.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On yimao, Concurrent Cavalier Attendant-in-ordinary Cui Ziwu was sent as envoy to Chen.

manualTranslations.zh: 庚申，司州牧、河南王孝瑜薨。
manualTranslations.literal: On the gengshen day, the Governor of Si Province, Prince Xiaoyu of Henan, died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Prince Xiaoyu of Henan, Governor of Si Province, died.

sourceRange.text: 夏四月戊午，大將軍、東安王婁叡坐事免。乙亥，陳人來聘。太史奏天文有變，其占當有易王。丙子，乃使太宰段韶兼太尉，持節奉皇帝璽綬傳位於皇太子，大赦，改元為天統元年，百官進級降罪各有差。又詔皇太子妃斛律氏為皇后。於是群公上尊號為太上皇帝，軍國大事咸以奏聞。始將傳政，使內參乘子尚乘驛送詔書於鄴。子尚出晉陽城，見人騎隨後，忽失之，尚未至鄴而其言已布矣。天統四年十二月辛未，太上皇帝崩於鄴宮乾壽堂，時年三十二，諡曰武成皇帝，廟號世祖。

localRange.text: 天統四年十二月辛未，太上皇帝崩於鄴宮乾壽堂，時年三十二，諡曰武成皇帝，廟號世祖。

context.beforeSource: 帝又夢之。
context.afterSource: 五年二月甲申，葬於永平陵。

context.afterLocal: 五年二月甲申，葬於永平陵。

manualTranslations.zh: 夏四月戊午，大將軍、東安王婁叡坐事免。
manualTranslations.literal: In summer, in the fourth month, on the wuwu day, Grand General and Prince Rui of Dong'an, Lou Rui, was dismissed for involvement in a case.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In summer, in the fourth month, on wuwu, Lou Rui, Grand General and Prince of Dong'an, was dismissed over an affair.

manualTranslations.zh: 乙亥，陳人來聘。
manualTranslations.literal: On the yihai day, people from Chen came on a diplomatic mission.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On yihai, envoys from Chen came to court.

manualTranslations.zh: 太史奏天文有變，其占當有易王。
manualTranslations.literal: The Grand Astrologer memorialized that there had been a change in the celestial patterns, and the prognostication indicated that there should be a change of ruler.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Grand Astrologer reported a celestial anomaly whose omen pointed to a change of ruler.

manualTranslations.zh: 丙子，乃使太宰段韶兼太尉，持節奉皇帝璽綬傳位於皇太子，大赦，改元為天統元年，百官進級降罪各有差。
manualTranslations.literal: On the bingzi day, he then had the Grand Minister Duan Shao concurrently serve as Grand Commandant and, bearing the credentials, present the imperial seals and ribbons to transmit the throne to the crown prince; a general amnesty was proclaimed, the era name was changed to the first year of Tiantong, and the hundred officials were advanced in grade and punishments reduced, each by rank.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Grand Minister Duan Shao, concurrently Grand Commandant, was sent with the credentials to convey the imperial seals and ribbons and transfer the throne to the crown prince. A general amnesty was proclaimed, the era was changed to Tiantong, and officials were advanced and punishments reduced by graded degrees.

manualTranslations.zh: 又詔皇太子妃斛律氏為皇后。
manualTranslations.literal: Another edict made the crown prince's consort, Lady Hulu, empress.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: A further edict made the crown prince's consort, Lady Hulu, empress.

manualTranslations.zh: 於是群公上尊號為太上皇帝，軍國大事咸以奏聞。
manualTranslations.literal: Thereupon the assembled lords presented him with the honorific title Retired Emperor, and all great affairs of the army and state were reported to him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The lords then offered him the title Retired Emperor, and all major military and state affairs continued to be submitted to him.

manualTranslations.zh: 始將傳政，使內參乘子尚乘驛送詔書於鄴。
manualTranslations.literal: At first, when he was about to transfer the government, he sent the Inner Cansheng Zishang by relay post to deliver the edict to Ye.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When he first prepared to hand over the government, he sent Zishang, an Inner Cansheng, by relay post to carry the edict to Ye.

manualTranslations.zh: 子尚出晉陽城，見人騎隨後，忽失之，尚未至鄴而其言已布矣。
manualTranslations.literal: When Zishang left Jinyang city, he saw a mounted man following behind him, who suddenly disappeared; before Zishang had reached Ye, the news had already spread.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: As Zishang left Jinyang, he saw a rider following him who suddenly vanished; before Zishang reached Ye, the news had already spread.

manualTranslations.zh: 天統四年十二月辛未，太上皇帝崩於鄴宮乾壽堂，時年三十二，諡曰武成皇帝，廟號世祖。
manualTranslations.literal: In the twelfth month of the fourth year of Tiantong, on the xinwei day, the retired emperor died in Qianshou Hall of Ye Palace. He was thirty-two. His posthumous title was Emperor Wucheng, and his temple name was Shizu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the fourth year of Tiantong, on xinwei, the retired emperor died in Qianshou Hall at Ye Palace. He was thirty-two. He was posthumously titled Emperor Wucheng, with the temple name Shizu.

sourceRange.text: 論曰：後主以中庸之姿，懷易染之性，永言先訓，教匪義方。

localRange.text: 論曰：武成風度高爽，經算弘長，文武之官，俱盡其力，有帝王之量矣。但愛狎庸豎，委以朝權，帷薄之間，淫侈過度，滅亡之兆，其在斯乎？玄象告變，傳位元子，名號雖殊，政猶己出，跡有虛飾，事非憲典，聰明臨下，何易可誣。又河南、河間、樂陵等諸王，或以時嫌，或以猜忌，皆無罪而殞，非所謂知命任天道之義也。後主以中庸之姿，懷易染之性，永言先訓，教匪義方。

sourceRange.text: 孝昭皇后元氏，開府元蠻女也。初為常山王妃。天保末，賜姓步六孤。孝昭即位，立為皇后。帝崩，梓宮之鄴。始渡汾橋，武成聞后有奇藥，追索之不得，使閹人就車頓辱。降居順成宮。武成既殺樂陵王，元被閟隔，不得與家相知。宮闈內忽有飛語，帝令檢推，得后父兄書信，元蠻由是坐免官。後以齊亡入周氏宮中。隋文帝作相，放還山東。

localRange.text: 孝昭元后武成胡后

manualTranslations.literal: Empress Yuan of Xiaozhao was the daughter of Yuan Man, a Commissioner with Protocol Equal to the Three Excellencies.

manualTranslations.zh: 初為常山王妃。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the end of the Tianbao era, she was granted the surname Buliugu.

manualTranslations.zh: 孝昭即位，立為皇后。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Xiaozhao took the throne, she was installed as empress.

manualTranslations.zh: 帝崩，梓宮之鄴。
manualTranslations.literal: When the emperor died, his coffin proceeded to Ye.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the emperor died, his coffin was taken to Ye.

manualTranslations.zh: 始渡汾橋，武成聞后有奇藥，追索之不得，使閹人就車頓辱。
manualTranslations.literal: When it first crossed the Fen Bridge, Wucheng heard that the empress had a wondrous medicine; he pursued and demanded it, but did not get it, and sent eunuchs to her carriage to humiliate her harshly.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: As the procession first crossed the Fen Bridge, Wucheng heard that the empress possessed a wondrous medicine. When his pursuit failed to obtain it, he sent eunuchs to her carriage to subject her to gross humiliation.

manualTranslations.zh: 降居順成宮。
manualTranslations.literal: She was demoted to live in Shuncheng Palace.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: She was demoted and made to live in Shuncheng Palace.

manualTranslations.zh: 武成既殺樂陵王，元被閟隔，不得與家相知。
manualTranslations.literal: After Wucheng killed the Prince of Leling, Yuan was shut away and isolated, unable to communicate with her family.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After Wucheng killed the Prince of Leling, Empress Yuan was shut away in isolation and could no longer communicate with her family.

manualTranslations.zh: 宮闈內忽有飛語，帝令檢推，得后父兄書信，元蠻由是坐免官。
manualTranslations.literal: Suddenly there was a rumor within the palace; the emperor ordered an investigation and obtained letters from the empress's father and brothers, and Yuan Man was implicated by this and dismissed from office.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When rumors suddenly circulated inside the palace, the emperor ordered an investigation. Letters from the empress's father and brothers were found, and Yuan Man was dismissed from office for it.

manualTranslations.zh: 後以齊亡入周氏宮中。
manualTranslations.literal: Later, when Qi fell, she entered the palace of the Zhou house.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Later, after Qi fell, she entered the palace of the Zhou dynasty.

manualTranslations.zh: 隋文帝作相，放還山東。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Wen of Sui served as chancellor, she was released to return east of the mountains.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Wen of Sui was serving as chancellor, she was released and allowed to return east of the mountains.

sourceRange.text: 論曰：神武肇興齊業，武明追蹤周亂。溫公之敗邦家，馮妃比跡褒後。然則汙隆之義，蓋有系焉。其餘作孽為眚，外平內蠹，鑒之近代，于齊為甚。

context.beforeSource: 輕霄後自療面，欲求見，太后、陸媼使禁掌之，竟不得見。
context.afterSource: 全文以中華書局、一九七二年十一月、第一版《北齊書》為本校。

manualTranslations.zh: 論曰：神武肇興齊業，武明追蹤周亂。
manualTranslations.literal: The appraisal says: Shenwu first raised the enterprise of Qi, but Wuming followed the track of Zhou's disorder.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The appraisal says: Shenwu founded Qi's enterprise, but Wuming followed the path of Zhou's disorder.

manualTranslations.zh: 溫公之敗邦家，馮妃比跡褒後。
manualTranslations.literal: Duke Wen's ruin of state and house, and Consort Feng matching the traces of Empress Bao, show the pattern.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Duke Wen's ruin of state and family, and Consort Feng's likeness to Empress Bao, show the pattern.

manualTranslations.zh: 然則汙隆之義，蓋有系焉。
manualTranslations.literal: Thus the principle of decline and flourishing surely has something on which it depends.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Thus rise and decline surely have their causes.

manualTranslations.zh: 其餘作孽為眚，外平內蠹，鑒之近代，于齊為甚。
manualTranslations.literal: As for the rest, they made evil and became calamity; outwardly there was peace, inwardly decay. Looking at recent ages, in Qi this was most extreme.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: As for the rest, their wrongdoing became disaster: outward peace, inward rot. Among recent dynasties, Qi was the worst example.

sourceRange.text: 任城王湝，神武第十子也，少明慧。天保初封。自孝昭、武成時，車駕還鄴，常令湝鎮晉陽，總幷省事，歷司徒、太尉、幷省錄尚書事。，拜太保、幷州刺史，別封正平郡公。時有婦人臨汾水浣衣，有乘馬人換其新靴馳而去者，婦人持故靴，詣州言之。湝召城外諸嫗，以靴示之，紿曰：「有乘馬人在路被賊劫害，遺此靴焉，得無親屬乎？」一嫗撫膺哭曰：「兒昨著此靴向妻家。」如其語，捕獲之。時稱明察。武平初，遷太師、司州牧，出為冀州刺史，加太宰，遷右丞相、都督、青州刺史。湝頻牧大藩，雖不潔己，然寬恕為吏人所懷。五年，青州崔蔚波等夜襲州城，湝部分倉卒之際，咸得齊整，擊賊，大破之。拜左丞相，轉瀛州刺史。及後主奔鄴，加湝大丞相。

context.beforeSource: 入關，依例授儀同，分配遠邊，卒於龍州。
context.afterSource: 及安德王稱尊號於晉陽，使劉子昂修啟於湝：「至尊出奔，宗廟旣重，群公勸迫，權主號令，事甯終歸叔父。

manualTranslations.zh: 任城王湝，神武第十子也，少明慧。
manualTranslations.literal: Prince of Rencheng, Jie, was the tenth son of Shenwu and was intelligent and perceptive from youth.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Prince Jie of Rencheng was the tenth son of Shenwu and was bright and perceptive from youth.

manualTranslations.zh: 天保初封。
manualTranslations.literal: He was enfeoffed at the beginning of Tianbao.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was enfeoffed at the opening of Tianbao.

manualTranslations.zh: 自孝昭、武成時，車駕還鄴，常令湝鎮晉陽，總幷省事，歷司徒、太尉、幷省錄尚書事。
manualTranslations.literal: From the times of Xiaozhao and Wucheng, whenever the imperial carriage returned to Ye, Jie was regularly ordered to garrison Jinyang and oversee the affairs of Bing Province; he successively served as Minister over the Masses, Grand Commandant, and Recorder of Affairs of the Secretariat in Bing Province.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the reigns of Xiaozhao and Wucheng, whenever the emperor returned to Ye, Jie was usually left to garrison Jinyang and supervise Bing Province. He served successively as Minister over the Masses, Grand Commandant, and Recorder of Affairs of the Secretariat in Bing Province.

manualTranslations.zh: 天統三年，拜太保、幷州刺史，別封正平郡公。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year of Tiantong, he was appointed Grand Guardian and Inspector of Bing Province, and was separately enfeoffed Duke of Zhengping Commandery.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third year of Tiantong he was appointed Grand Guardian and Inspector of Bing Province, and separately made Duke of Zhengping Commandery.

manualTranslations.zh: 時有婦人臨汾水浣衣，有乘馬人換其新靴馳而去者，婦人持故靴，詣州言之。
manualTranslations.literal: At the time, a woman was washing clothes by the Fen River when a mounted man exchanged her new boots and rode away; the woman took the old boots and went to the provincial office to report it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the time a woman washing clothes by the Fen River had her new boots swapped by a mounted man who then rode off. She took the old boots to the provincial office and reported it.

manualTranslations.zh: 湝召城外諸嫗，以靴示之，紿曰：「有乘馬人在路被賊劫害，遺此靴焉，得無親屬乎？」
manualTranslations.literal: Jie summoned the old women outside the city, showed them the boots, and deceived them, saying, "A mounted man was robbed and killed by bandits on the road, leaving these boots behind. Might he have any kin among you?"
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Jie summoned the old women outside the city, showed them the boots, and said deceptively, "A rider was robbed and killed on the road and left these boots behind. Could he be a relative of yours?"

manualTranslations.zh: 一嫗撫膺哭曰：「兒昨著此靴向妻家。」
manualTranslations.literal: One old woman beat her breast and cried, saying, "My son wore these boots yesterday when he went to his wife's family."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: One old woman beat her breast and cried, "My son wore these boots yesterday when he went to his wife's family."

manualTranslations.zh: 如其語，捕獲之。
manualTranslations.literal: Following her words, they arrested and captured him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Following her statement, they caught him.

manualTranslations.zh: 時稱明察。
manualTranslations.literal: At the time, people praised him as discerning in investigation.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: People at the time praised his keen discernment.

manualTranslations.zh: 武平初，遷太師、司州牧，出為冀州刺史，加太宰，遷右丞相、都督、青州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of Wuping, he was transferred to Grand Preceptor and Governor of Si Province, then sent out as Inspector of Ji Province, additionally made Grand Minister, and transferred to Right Chancellor, Area Commander, and Inspector of Qing Province.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the opening of Wuping he became Grand Preceptor and Governor of Si Province, was then sent out as Inspector of Ji Province, additionally made Grand Minister, and later transferred to Right Chancellor, Area Commander, and Inspector of Qing Province.

manualTranslations.zh: 湝頻牧大藩，雖不潔己，然寬恕為吏人所懷。
manualTranslations.literal: Jie repeatedly governed great provinces; although he did not keep himself pure, his generosity and forbearance won the attachment of officials and people.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Jie often governed major provinces. Though he was not personally incorrupt, his generosity and leniency endeared him to officials and commoners.

manualTranslations.zh: 五年，青州崔蔚波等夜襲州城，湝部分倉卒之際，咸得齊整，擊賊，大破之。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fifth year, Cui Weibo and others of Qing Province attacked the provincial city by night; in the sudden emergency, Jie deployed his forces and all were orderly, struck the bandits, and badly defeated them.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, Cui Weibo and others in Qing Province launched a night attack on the provincial city. In the emergency Jie organized his divisions in good order, struck the attackers, and routed them.

manualTranslations.zh: 拜左丞相，轉瀛州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: He was appointed Left Chancellor and transferred to Inspector of Ying Province.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was appointed Left Chancellor and then transferred to Inspector of Ying Province.

manualTranslations.zh: 及後主奔鄴，加湝大丞相。
manualTranslations.literal: When Houzhu fled to Ye, Jie was additionally made Grand Chancellor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Houzhu fled to Ye, Jie was made Grand Chancellor.

localRange.text: 高祖十一王永安簡平王浚平陽靖翼王淹彭城景思王浟上党剛肅王渙襄城景王淯任城王湝高陽康穆王湜博陵文簡王濟華山王凝馮翊王潤漢陽敬懷王洽神武皇帝十五男：武明婁皇后生文襄皇帝、文宣皇帝、孝昭皇帝、襄城景王淯、武成皇帝、博陵文簡王濟，王氏生永安簡平王浚，穆氏生平陽靖翼王淹，大尒朱氏生彭城景思王浟、華山王凝，韓氏生上党剛肅王渙，小尒朱氏生任城王湝，游氏生高陽康穆王湜，鄭氏生馮翊王潤，馮氏生漢陽敬懷王洽。

sourceRange.text: 平陽靖翼王淹，字子邃，神武第四子也。元象中，封平陽郡公，累遷尚書左僕射。天保初，進爵為王，歷位尚書令、開府儀同三司、司空、太尉。皇建初，為太傅，與彭城、河間王並給仗衛、羽林百人。，遷太宰。性沉謹，以寬厚稱。，薨於晉陽，或云酖終。還葬鄴，贈假黃鉞、太宰、錄尚書事。子德素嗣。

manualTranslations.zh: 平陽靖翼王淹，字子邃，神武第四子也。
manualTranslations.literal: Prince Jingyi of Pingyang, Yan, style name Zisui, was the fourth son of Shenwu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Prince Jingyi of Pingyang, Yan, whose style name was Zisui, was the fourth son of Shenwu.

manualTranslations.zh: 元象中，封平陽郡公，累遷尚書左僕射。
manualTranslations.literal: During the Yuanxiang era, he was enfeoffed Duke of Pingyang Commandery and was repeatedly promoted, reaching Left Vice Director of the Secretariat.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During the Yuanxiang era he was made Duke of Pingyang Commandery and rose through successive offices to Left Vice Director of the Secretariat.

manualTranslations.zh: 天保初，進爵為王，歷位尚書令、開府儀同三司、司空、太尉。
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of Tianbao, his title was advanced to prince, and he successively held the offices of Chief Minister of the Secretariat, Commissioner with Protocol Equal to the Three Excellencies, Minister of Works, and Grand Commandant.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the opening of Tianbao he was raised to princely rank and went on to serve as Chief Minister of the Secretariat, Commissioner with Protocol Equal to the Three Excellencies, Minister of Works, and Grand Commandant.

manualTranslations.zh: 皇建初，為太傅，與彭城、河間王並給仗衛、羽林百人。
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of Huangjian, he became Grand Tutor, and he, the Prince of Pengcheng, and the Prince of Hejian were all given armed guards and one hundred Yulin troops.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Huangjian he was made Grand Tutor; he, the Prince of Pengcheng, and the Prince of Hejian were each assigned armed guards and one hundred Yulin troops.

manualTranslations.zh: 大寧元年，遷太宰。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Daning, he was transferred to Grand Minister.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Daning he was moved to Grand Minister.

manualTranslations.zh: 性沉謹，以寬厚稱。
manualTranslations.literal: By nature he was deep and careful, and was known for generosity and kindness.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was reserved and careful by temperament, and was known for breadth and kindness.

manualTranslations.zh: 河清三年，薨於晉陽，或云酖終。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year of Heqing, he died at Jinyang; some say he ended by poison.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third year of Heqing he died at Jinyang; some said he died by poisoning.

sourceRange.text: 與呼延族、莫多婁敬顯、尉相願同謀，期正月五日Category:PD-old

與呼延族、莫多婁敬顯、尉相願同謀，期正月五日[2]，孝珩於千秋門斬高阿那肱，相願在內以禁兵應之，族與敬顯自遊豫園勒兵出。既而阿那肱從別宅取便路入宮，事不果。乃求出拒西軍，謂阿那肱、韓長鸞、陳德信等云：「朝廷不賜遣擊賊，豈不畏孝珩反耶？孝珩破宇文邕，遂至長安，反時何與國家事。以今日之急，猶作如此猜疑。高、韓恐其變，出孝珩為滄州刺史。至州，以五千人會任城王於信都，共為匡復計。周齊王憲來伐，兵弱不能敵。怒曰：「由高阿那肱小人，吾道窮矣！齊叛臣乞扶令和以矟刺孝珩墜馬，奴白澤以身扞之，孝珩猶傷數處，遂見虜。齊王憲問孝珩齊亡所由，孝珩自陳國難，辭淚俱下，俯仰有節。憲為之改容，親為洗創傅藥，禮遇甚厚。孝珩獨歎曰：「李穆叔言齊氏二十八年，今果然矣。自神武皇帝以外，吾諸父兄弟無一人得至四十者，命也。嗣君無獨見之明，宰相非柱石之寄，恨不得握兵符，受廟算，展我心力耳。至長安，依例授開府、縣侯。後周武帝在雲陽，宴齊君臣，自彈胡琵琶，命孝珩吹笛。辭曰：「亡國之音，不足聽也。固命之，舉笛裁至口，淚下嗚咽，武帝乃止。其年十月，疾甚，啟歸葬山東，從之。尋卒，令還葬鄴。孝琬以文襄世嫡，驕矜自負。河南王之死，諸王在宮內莫敢舉聲，唯孝琬大哭而出。又怨執政，為草人而射之。和士開與祖珽譖之，云：「草人擬聖躬也。又前突厥至州，孝琬脫兜鍪抵地，云『豈是老嫗，須著此』。此言屬大家也。初，魏世謠言：「河南種穀河北生，白楊樹頭金雞鳴。珽以說曰：「河南、河北，河間也。金雞鳴，孝琬將建金雞而大赦。帝頗惑之。時孝琬得佛牙，置於第內，夜有神光。昭玄都法順請以奏聞[3]，不從。帝聞，使搜之，得鎮庫矟幡數百。帝聞之，以為反。訊其諸姬，有陳氏者無寵，誣對曰「孝琬畫作陛下形哭之」，然實是文襄像，孝琬時時對之泣。帝怒，使武纫赫連輔玄倒鞭撾之。孝琬呼阿叔，帝怒曰：「誰是爾叔？敢喚我作叔！孝琬曰：「神武皇帝嫡孫，文襄皇帝嫡子，魏孝靜皇帝外甥，何為不得喚作叔也？帝愈怒，折其兩脛而死。瘞諸西山，帝崩後，乃改葬。子正禮嗣，幼聰穎，能誦左氏春秋。齊亡，遷綿州卒。蘭陵武王長恭，一名孝瓘，文襄第四子也。累遷并州刺史。突厥入晉陽，長恭盡力擊之。芒山之敗[4]，長恭為中軍，率五百騎再入周軍，遂至金墉之下，被圍甚急，城上人弗識，長恭免冑示之面，乃下弩手救之，於是大捷。武士共歌謠之，為蘭陵王入陣曲是也。歷司州牧、青瀛二州，頗受財貨。後為太尉，與段韶討栢谷，又攻定陽。韶病，長恭總其衆。前後以戰功別封鉅鹿、長樂、樂平、高陽等郡公。芒山之捷，後主謂長恭曰：「入陣太深，失利悔無所及。對曰：「家事親切，不覺遂然。帝嫌其稱家事，遂忌之。及在定陽，其屬尉相願謂曰：「王既受朝寄，何得如此貪殘？長恭未答。相願曰：「豈不由芒山大捷，恐以威武見忌，欲自穢乎？長恭曰：「然。相願曰：「朝廷若忌王，於此犯便當行罰，求福反以速禍。長恭泣下，前膝請以安身術。相願曰：「王前既有勳，今復告捷，威聲太重，宜屬疾在家，勿預事。長恭然其言，未能退。及江淮寇擾，恐復為將，歎曰：「我去年面腫，今何不發。自是有疾不療。武平四年五月，帝使徐之範飲以毒藥。長恭謂妃鄭氏曰：「我忠以事上，何辜於天，而遭鴆也。妃曰：「何不求見天顏。長恭曰：「天顏何由可見。遂飲藥薨。贈太尉。長恭貌柔心壯，音容兼美。為將躬勤細事，每得甘美，雖一瓜數果，必與將士共之。初在瀛州，行參軍陽士深表列其贓，免官。及討定陽，士深在軍[5]，恐禍及。長恭聞之曰：「吾本無此意。乃求小失，杖士深二十以安之。嘗入朝而僕從盡散，唯有一人，長恭獨還，無所譴罰。武成賞其功，命賈護為買妾二十人，唯受其一。有千金責券，臨死日，盡燔之。安德王延宗，文襄第五子也。母陳氏，廣陽王妓也。延宗幼為文宣所養，年十二，猶騎置腹上，令溺己臍中，抱之曰：「可憐止有此一箇。問欲作何王，對曰：「欲作衝天王。文宣問楊愔，愔曰：「天下無此郡名，願使安於德。於是封安德焉。為定州刺史，於樓上大便，使人在下張口承之。以蒸嚢糝和人糞以飼左右，有難色者鞭之。孝昭帝聞之，使趙道德就州杖之一百。道德以延宗受杖不謹，又加三十。又以囚試刀，驗其利鈍。驕縱多不法。武成使撻之，殺其昵近九人，從是深自改悔。蘭陵王芒山凱捷，自陳兵勢，諸兄弟咸壯之。延宗獨曰：「四兄非大丈夫，何不乘勝徑入？使延宗當此勢，關西豈得復存。及蘭陵死，妃鄭氏以頸珠施佛。廣寧王使贖之。延宗手書以諫，而淚滿紙。河間死，延宗哭之淚亦甚。又為草人以像武成，鞭而訊之曰：「何故殺我兄！奴告之，武成覆臥延宗於地，馬鞭撾之二百，幾死。後歷司徒、太尉。及平陽之役，後主自禦之，命延宗率右軍先戰，城下擒周開府宗挺。及大戰，延宗以麾下再入周軍，莫不披靡。諸軍敗，延宗獨全軍。後主將奔晉陽，延宗言：「大家但在營莫動，以兵馬付臣，臣能破之。帝不納。及至并州，又聞周軍已入雀鼠谷[6]，乃以延宗為相國、并州刺史，總山西兵事。謂曰：「并州，阿兄自取，兒今去也。延宗曰：「陛下為社稷莫動，臣為陛下出死力戰。駱提婆曰：「至尊計已成，王不得輒沮。後主竟奔鄴。在并將率咸請曰：「王若不作天子，諸人實不能出死力。延宗不得已，即皇帝位，下詔曰：「武平孱弱，政由宦豎，釁結蕭牆，盜起疆埸。斬關夜遁，莫知所之，則我高祖之業將墜於地。王公卿士，猥見推逼，今便祗承寶位。可大赦天下，改武平七年為德昌元年。以晉昌王唐邕為宰輔，齊昌王莫多婁敬顯、沭陽王和阿于子[7]、右纫大將軍段暢、武纫將軍相里僧伽、開府韓骨胡、侯莫陳洛州為爪牙。衆聞之，不召而至者，前後相屬。延宗容貌充壯，坐則仰，偃則伏，人笑之，乃赫然奮發。氣力絕異，馳騁行陣，勁捷若飛。傾覆府藏及後宮美女，以賜將士，籍沒內參千餘家。後主謂近臣曰：「我寧使周得并州，不欲安德得之。左右曰：「理然。延宗見士卒，皆親執手，陳辭自稱名，流涕嗚咽。红皆爭為死，童兒女子亦乘屋攘袂，投蝋石以禦周軍。特進、開府那盧安生守太谷，以萬兵叛。周軍圍晉陽，望之如黑雲四合。延宗命莫多婁敬顯、韓骨胡拒城南，和阿于子、段暢拒城東。延宗親當周齊王於城北，奮大矟，往來督戰，所向無前。尚書令史沮山亦肥大多力，捉長刀步從，殺傷甚多。武衞蘭芙蓉、綦連延長皆死於陣。阿于子、段暢以千騎投周。周軍攻東門，際昏，遂入。進兵焚佛寺門屋，飛燄照天地。延宗與敬顯自門入，夾擊之，周軍大亂，爭門相填壓，齊人從後斫刺，死者二千餘人。周武帝左右略盡，自拔無路，承御上士張壽輒牽馬頭，賀拔佛恩以鞭拂其後，崎嶇僅得出。齊人奮擊，幾中焉。城東阨曲，佛恩及降者皮子信為之導，僅免，時四更也。延宗謂周武帝崩於亂兵，使於積屍中求長鬣者，不得。時齊人既勝，入坊飲酒，盡醉臥，延宗不復能整。周武帝出城，饑甚，欲為遁逸計。齊王憲及柱國王誼諫，以為去必不免。延宗叛將段暢亦盛言城內空虛。周武帝乃駐馬，鳴角收兵，俄頃復振。詰旦，還攻東門，剋之，又入南門。延宗戰，力屈，走至城北，於人家見禽。周武帝自投下馬，執其手。延宗辭曰：「死人手何敢迫至尊。帝曰：「兩國天子，有何怨惡，直為百姓來耳。勿怖，終不相害。使復衣帽，禮之。先是，高都郡有山焉，絕壁臨水，忽有黑書見，云「齊亡延宗」，洗視逾明。帝使人就寫，使者改亡為上。至是應焉。延宗敗前，在鄴廳事，見兩日相連置，以十二月十三日晡時受勑守并州，明日建尊號，不間日而被圍，經宿，至食時而敗。年號德昌，好事者言其得二日云。既而周武帝問取鄴計。辭曰：「亡國大夫不可以圖存，此非臣所及。強問之，乃曰：「若任城王援鄴，臣不能知，若今主自守，陛下兵不血刃。及至長安，周武與齊君臣飲酒，令後主起舞，延宗悲不自持。屢欲仰藥自裁，傅婢苦執諫而止。未幾，周武誣後主及延宗等，云遙應穆提婆反，使並賜死。皆自陳無之，延宗攘袂，泣而不言。皆以椒塞口而死。明年，李妃收殯之。後主之傳位於太子也，孫正言竊謂人曰：「我武定中為廣州士曹[9]，聞襄城人曹普演有言，高王諸兒，阿保當為天子，至高德之承之當滅。阿保謂天保，德之謂德昌也，承之謂後主年號承光，其言竟信云。漁陽王紹信，文襄第六子也。歷特進、開府、中領軍、護軍、青州刺史。行過漁陽，與大富人鍾長命同祷坐。太守鄭道蓋謁，長命欲起，紹信不聽，曰：「此何物小人，而主人公為起。乃與長命結為義兄弟，妃與長命妻為姊妹，責其闔家幼長皆有贈賄，鍾氏因此遂貧。齊滅，死於長安。北齊書卷十一按此卷原缺，後人以北史卷五二齊宗室諸王傳下文襄諸子傳補。三朝本、南本卷後有宋人校語「此卷與北史同」。期正月五日諸本「月」作「旦」。北史卷五二及冊府卷二八六三三六八頁作「月」。按正旦五日不可通，今據北史改。夜有神光昭玄都法順請以奏聞諸本「昭」作「照室」二字，北史卷五二單作「照」。按魏書卷一一四釋老志、隋書卷二七百官志中，魏末齊初管理佛教的機構叫「昭玄」，北齊置大統一人，統一人。昭玄大統也叫昭玄都，北史卷三二崔暹傳見昭玄都法上，本書卷二四杜弼傳見昭玄都僧達。北史「昭」訛「照」，補此傳者以為不可通，妄加「室」字，今改正。芒山之敗冊府卷二一八二六一六頁「敗」作「戰」，通志卷八五北齊宗室傳作「役」。按河清三年五六四芒山之戰，北齊獲勝，詳見本書卷一六段韶傳、卷一七斛律光傳，此段下文也說「大捷」這裏「敗」字必誤。及討定陽士深在軍諸本「定」下有「州」字，北史無。按定州屬北齊，這時並未發生什麼變化，高長恭是北齊王子，怎會去攻討。上文已云長恭和段韶攻定陽，這裏正指此事。後人以「陽士深」連讀，妄增「州」字，今據北史刪。又聞周軍已入雀鼠谷三朝本、南本、北本、殿本「雀」作「浔」，即「貂」字。汲本、局本作「润」，不成字。按水經注卷六汾水「又南過冠爵津」，注云：「汾津名，在界休縣之西南，俗謂之雀鼠谷，數十里間道險隘。通鑑卷一七二五三六〇頁衅周軍追齊後主事，胡注引宋白曰：「靈石縣東南有高壁嶺、雀鼠谷、汾水關，皆汾西險固之地。雀鼠谷是周軍自晉州經靈石、介休向太原進軍的必經之路，別無所謂「浔鼠谷」，今改正。沭陽王和阿于子諸本及北史卷五二「沭」作「沐」，局本及通鑑卷一七二五三六二頁、通志卷八五北齊宗室傳作「沭」。按沭陽屬東海郡，見隋書卷三一地理志下，今從局本。李妃收殯之諸本「妃」作「起」，北史卷五二作「妃」。按本書卷三七魏收傳補、北史卷三三李孝貞傳都說延宗娶李氏，作「妃」是，今據改。我武定中為廣州士曹諸本「武定」作「保定」，北史作「武定」。按此事又見本書卷四九綦母懷文傳補，亦作「武定」。保定是周武帝年號，這時高洋早已稱帝，與下文「高王諸兒」云云不符。今據北史改。

sourceRange.text: 河南康献王孝瑜，字正德，文襄長子也。初封河南郡公，齊受禪，進爵為王。歷位中書令、司州牧。初，孝瑜養於神武宮中，與武成同年相愛。將誅楊愔等，孝瑜預其謀。及武成即位，禮遇特隆。帝在晉陽，手勑之曰：「吾飲汾清二盃，勸汝於鄴酌兩盃。」其親愛如此。孝瑜容貌魁偉，精彩雄毅，謙慎寬厚，兼愛文學，讀書敏速，十行俱下，覆缱不失一道。初，文襄於鄴東起山池遊觀，時俗眩之。孝瑜遂於第作水堂、龍舟，植幡矟於舟上，數集諸弟宴射為樂。武成幸其第，見而悅之，故盛興後園之玩，於是貴賤慕矅，處處營造。

localRange.text: 北齊書卷十一[1]文襄六王河南康舒王孝瑜廣寧王孝珩河間王孝琬蘭陵武王孝瓘安德王延宗漁陽王紹信文襄六男：文敬元皇后生河間王孝琬，宋氏生河南王孝瑜，王氏生廣寧王孝珩，蘭陵王長恭不得母氏姓，陳氏生安德王延宗，燕氏生漁陽王紹信。

sourceRange.text: 論曰：武成殘忍姦穢，事極人倫。

localRange.text: 論曰：文襄諸子，咸有風骨，雖文雅之道，有謝間平，然武藝英姿，多堪禦侮。縱咸陽賜劍，覆敗有徵，若使蘭陵獲全，未可量也，而終見誅翦，以至土崩，可為太息者矣。安德以時艱主暗，匿跡韜光，及平陽之陣，奮其忠勇，蓋以臨難見危，義深家國。德昌大舉，事迫羣情，理至淪亡，無所歸命。廣寧請出後宮，竟不獲遂，非孝珩辭致有謝李同，自是後主心識去平原已遠。存亡事異，安可同年而說。武成殘忍姦穢，事極人倫。

sourceRange.text: 初徽嘗過長安市，與婦人王氏私通而生歸彥，至是年已九歲。神武追見之，撫對悲喜。稍遷徐州刺史。歸彥少質朴，後更改節，放縱好聲色，朝夕酣歌。妻魏上黨王元天穆女也，貌不美而甚驕妒，數忿爭，密啟文宣求離，事寢不報。天保元年，封平秦王。嫡妃康及所生母王氏並為太妃。善事二母，以孝聞。徵為兼侍郎，稍被親寵。以討侯景功，別封長樂郡公，除領軍大將軍。領軍加大，自歸彥始也。文宣誅高德正，金寶財貨悉以賜之。幹明初，拜司徒，仍總知禁衛。

sourceRange.text: 昭兄子叡。叡字佛仁，父拔，魏南部尚書。叡幼孤，被叔父昭所養。為神武帳內都督，封掖縣子，累遷光州刺史。在任貪縱，深為文襄所責。後改封九門縣公。齊受禪，得除領軍將軍，別封安定侯。叡無他器干，以外戚貴幸，縱情財色。為瀛州刺史，聚斂無厭。皇建初，封東安王。大寧元年，進位司空。平高歸彥於冀州，還拜司徒。河清三年，濫殺人，為尚書左丞宋仲羨彈奏，經赦乃免。尋為太尉，以軍功進大司馬。武成至河陽，仍遣總偏師赴懸瓠。叡在豫境留停百餘日，專行非法，詔免官，以王還第。尋除太尉，薨。贈大司馬。子子彥嗣，位開府儀同三司。厙狄干，善無人也。曾祖越豆眷，魏道武時以功割善無之西臘汙山地方百里以處之，後率部北遷，因家朔方。干梗直少言，有武藝。魏正光初，除掃逆黨，授將軍，宿衛於內。以家在寒鄉，不宜毒暑，冬得入京師，夏歸鄉里。孝昌元年，北邊擾亂，奔雲中，為刺史費穆送於尒朱榮。以軍主隨榮入洛。

context.afterSource: 後從神武起兵，破四胡於韓陵，封廣平縣公，尋進郡公。

sourceRange.text: 神武將出信都，昭贊成大策，卽以為中軍大都督。從破尒朱兆於廣阿，封安喜縣伯，改濟北公，又徙濮陽郡公，授領軍將軍。魏孝武將貳於神武，昭以疾辭還晉陽。從神武入洛，兗州刺史樊子鵠反，以昭為東道大都督討之。子鵠既死，諸將勸昭盡捕誅其黨。昭曰：「此州無狀，橫被殘賊，其君是怨，其人何罪。」遂皆捨焉。後轉大司馬，仍領軍。遷司徒，出為定州刺史。昭好酒，晚得偏風，雖愈，猶不能處劇務，在州事委僚屬，昭舉其大綱而已。薨於州。贈假黃鉞、太師、太尉，諡曰武。齊受禪，詔祭告其墓，封太原王。皇建初，配享神武廟庭。長子仲達嗣，改封濮陽王。

sourceRange.text: 肅宗踐阼，納其孫女為皇太子妃。又詔金朝見，聽步挽車至階。世祖登極，禮遇彌重，又納其孫女為太子妃。金長子光大將軍，次子羨及孫武都並開府儀同三司，出鎮方岳，其餘子孫皆封侯貴達。一門一皇后、二太子妃、三公主，尊寵之盛，當時莫比。金嘗謂光曰：「我雖不讀書，聞古來外戚梁冀等無不傾滅。女若有寵，諸貴人妒；女若無寵，天子嫌之。我家直以立.勳抱忠致富貴，豈可藉女也？」辭不獲免，常以為憂。薨，年八十。世祖舉哀西堂，後主又舉哀於晉陽宮。贈假黃鉞、使持節、都督朔定冀並瀛青齊滄幽肆晉汾十二州諸軍事、相國、太尉公、錄尚書、朔州刺史，酋長、王如故，贈錢百萬，謚曰武。子光嗣。

sourceRange.text: 高祖起義，以都督從。稍遷平北將軍、顯州刺史，加鎮南將軍，封固安縣伯。尋進為侯，行肆州刺史。周文帝遣其右將軍李小光據梁州，平以偏師討擒之。出為燕州刺史。入兼左衛將軍，領衆一萬討北徐賊，破之，除濟州刺史。侯景度江，詔平為大都督，率青州刺史敬顯俊、左衛將軍厙狄伏連等略定壽陽、宿預三十餘城。事罷還州，加開府，進位驃騎大將軍，進爵為公。顯祖受禪，別封羨陽侯。行兗州刺史，以黷貨除名。後除開府儀同三司。廢帝即位，拜特進，食滄州樂陵郡幹。皇建初，封定陽郡公，拜護軍。後為青州刺史，卒。贈太尉。

sourceRange.text: 齊受禪，以有翼贊之功，別封須昌縣公，尋除司空。子如性滑稽，不治檢裁，言戲穢褻，識者非之。而事姊有禮，撫諸兄子慈篤，當時名士並加欽愛，世以此稱之。然素無鯁正，不能平心處物。世宗時，中尉崔暹、黃門郎崔季舒俱被任用。世宗崩，暹等赴晉陽。子如乃啟顯祖，言其罪惡，仍勸誅之。其後子如以馬度關，為有司所奏。顯祖引子如數讓之曰：「崔暹、季舒事朕先世，有何大罪，卿令我殺之？」因此免官。久之，猶以先帝之舊，拜太尉。尋以疾薨，時年六十四。贈使持節、都督冀定瀛滄懷五州諸軍事、太師、太尉、懷州刺史，贈物一千段，諡曰文明。

sourceRange.text: 貴凡所經歷，莫不肆其威酷。修營城郭，督責切峻，非理殺害，視下如草芥。然以嚴斷濟務，有益機速。性峭直，攻訐無所迴避，故見賞於時。雖非佐命元功，然與高祖布衣之舊，特見親重。興和元年十一月卒。贈冀定幷殷瀛五州軍事、太保、太尉公、錄尚書事、冀州刺史，諡曰忠武。齊受禪，詔祭告其墓。皇建中，配享高祖廟庭。長子元孫，員外郎、肆州中正，早卒。贈肆州刺史。次子洪徽嗣。武平末，假儀同三司，奏門下事。

sourceRange.text: 九年，又討賊有功，賜帛一百疋、錢十萬。十年，詔除揚州行臺，與王貴顯、侯子監將兵衛送蕭莊。築郭默、若邪二城。與陳新蔡太守魯悉達戰大蛇洞，破走之。又監蕭莊、王琳軍，與陳將侯瑱、侯安都戰於蕪湖，敗歸。皇建初，別封成陽郡公。天統二年，除特進。四年十月，又別封猗氏縣公，並賜金銀酒鐘各一枚、胡馬一匹。五年四月，進爵為義安王。武平元年，出為光州刺史。儼少任俠，交通輕薄，遨遊京洛間。及從征討，每立功效，經略雖非所長，而有將帥之節。所歷諸州，雖不能清白守道，亦不貪殘。卒，贈司徒、尚書令。子子颙，給事黃門侍郎。

sourceRange.text: 」，除給事黃門侍郎。與趙郡李概為莫逆之友。概將東還，瞻遺之書曰：「仗氣使酒，我之常弊，詆訶指切，在卿尤甚。足下告歸，吾於何聞過也？」瞻患氣，兼性遲重，雖居二省，竟不堪敷奏。加征虜將軍，除清河邑中正。肅宗踐祚，皇太子就傅受業，詔除太子中庶子，徵赴晉陽。勑專在東宮，調護講讀，及進退禮度，皆歸委焉。太子納妃斛律氏，勑瞻與鴻臚崔劼撰定婚禮儀注。仍面受別旨曰：「雖有舊事，恐未盡善，可好定此儀，以為後式。」，除衛尉少卿，尋兼散騎常侍，聘陳使主。瞻詞韻溫雅，南人大相欽服，乃言：「常侍前朝通好之日，何意不來？」其見重如此。還除太常少卿，加冠軍將軍，轉尚書吏部郎中。因患急十餘日。舊式，百日不上解官，吏部尚書尉瑾性褊急，以瞻舉指舒緩，曹務繁劇，遂附驛奏聞，因而被代。瞻遂免歸鄉里。天統末，加驃騎大將軍，就拜銀青光祿大夫。卒，時年五十四。贈使持節、都督濟州軍事、大理卿、刺史，諡曰文。

sourceRange.text: 元韶，字世胄，魏孝莊之侄。避尒朱之難，匿於嵩山。性好學，美容儀。初，尒朱榮將入洛，父劭恐，以韶寄所親滎陽太守鄭仲明。仲明尋為城人所殺，韶因亂與乳母相失，遂與仲明兄子僧副避難。路中為賊逼，僧副恐不免，因令韶下馬。僧副謂客曰：「窮鳥投入，尚或矜愍，況諸王如何棄乎？」僧副舉刃逼之，客乃退。韶逢一老母姓程，哀之，隱於私家十餘日，莊帝訪而獲焉，襲封彭城王。齊神武帝以孝武帝後配之。魏室奇寶，多隨後入韶家。有二玉缽相盛，可轉而不可出；馬瑙榼容三升，玉縫之。皆稱西域鬼作也。歷位太尉、侍中、錄尚書、司州牧，進太傅。齊，降爵為縣公。

sourceRange.text: 旣而趙郡。公。增年獲免，收知而過之，事發除名。其年又以托附陳使封孝琰，牒令其門客與行，遇崑崙舶至，得奇貨猓然褥表、美玉盈尺等數十件，罪當流，以贖論。三年，起除清都尹。尋遣黃門郎元文遙勑收曰：「卿舊人，事我家最久，前者之罪，情在可恕。比令卿為尹，非謂美授，但初起卿，斟酌如此。朕豈可用卿之才而忘卿身，待至十月，當還卿開府。」，除左光祿大夫。二年，行齊州刺史，尋為真。收以子侄少年，申以戒厲，著《枕中篇》，其詞曰：其後羣臣多言魏史不實，武成復勑更審，收又回換。

localRange.text: 收以子侄少年，申以戒厲，著《枕中篇》，其詞曰：吾曾覽管子之書，其言曰：「任之重者莫如身，途之畏者莫如口，期之遠者莫如年。以重任行畏途，至遠期，惟君子為能及矣。追而味之，喟然長息。若夫岳立為重，有潛戴而不傾；山藏稱固，亦趨負而弗停；呂梁獨浚，能行歌而匪惕；焦原作險，或躋踵而不驚；九陔方集，故眇然而迅舉；五紀當定，想窅乎而上征。茍任重也有度，則任之而愈固；乘危也有術，蓋乘之而靡恤。彼期遠而能通，果應之而可必。豈神理之獨爾，亦人事其如一。嗚呼！處天壤之間，勞死生之地，攻之以嗜欲，牽之以名利，粱肉不期而共臻，珠玉無足而俱致；於是乎驕奢仍作，危亡旋至。然則上知大賢，唯幾唯哲，或出或處，不常其節。其舒也濟世成務，其卷也聲銷跡滅。玉帛子女，椒蘭律呂，諂諛無所先；稱肉度骨，膏唇挑舌，怨惡莫之前。勳名共山河同久，志業與金石比堅。斯蓋厚棟不橈，遊刃砉然。逮於厥德不常，喪其金璞。馳騖人世，鼓動流俗。挾湯日而謂寒，包溪壑而未足。源不清而流濁，表不端而影曲。嗟乎！膠漆詎堅，寒暑甚促。反利而成害，化榮而就辱。欣戚更來，得喪仍續。至有身禦魑魅，魂沈狴獄。詎非足力不強，迷在當局。孰可謂車戒前傾，人師先覺。聞諸君子，雅道之士，遊遨經術，厭飫文史。筆有奇鋒，談有勝理。孝悌之至，神明通矣。審道而行，量路而止。自我及物，先人後己。情無繫於榮悴，心靡滯於慍喜。不養望於丘壑，不待價於城市。言行相顧，慎終猶始。有一於斯，鬱為羽儀。恪居展事，知無不為。或左或右，則髦士攸宜；無悔無吝，故高而不危。異乎勇進忘退，茍得患失，射千金之產，邀萬鐘之秩，投烈風之門，趣炎火之室，載蹶而墜其貽宴，或蹲乃喪其貞吉。可不畏歟！可不戒歟！門有倚禍，事不可不密；墻有伏寇，言不可而失。宜諦其言，宜端其行。言之不善，行之不正，鬼執強梁，人囚徑廷。幽奪其魄，明夭其命。不服非法，不行非道。公鼎為己信，私玉非身寶。過涅為紺，踰藍作青。持繩視直，置水觀平。時然後取，未若無欲。知止知足，庶免於辱。是以為必察其幾，舉必慎於微。知幾慮微，斯亡則稀。旣察且慎，福祿攸歸。昔蘧瑗識四十九非，顏子幾三月不違。跬步無已，至於千里。覆一簣進，及於萬仞。故云行遠自邇，登高自卑，可大可久，與世推移。月滿如規，後夜則虧。槿榮于枝，望暮而萎。夫奚益而非損，孰有損而不害？益不欲多，利不欲大。唯居德者畏其甚，體真者懼其大。道尊則群謗集，任重而衆怨會。其達也則尼父棲遑，其忠也而周公狼狽。無曰人之我狹，在我不可而覆。無曰人之我厚，在我不可而咎。如山之大，無不有也；如谷之虛，無不受也；能剛能柔，重可負也；能信能順，險可走也；能知能愚，期可久也。周廟之人，三緘其口。漏巵在前，欹器留後。俾諸來裔，傳之坐右。其後羣臣多言魏史不實，武成復勑更審，收又回換。

sourceRange.text: 大寧元年，加開府。二年，轉右衛將軍，尋轉右衛大將軍。天統初，判幷省尚書右僕射，尋出為徐州刺史。四年，除豫州道行臺僕射、豫州刺史，加開府儀同三司。武平三年，進授行臺尚書令，刺史如故，封歷陽郡王。景安之在邊州，鄰接他境，綏和邊鄙，不相侵暴，人物安之。又管內蠻多華少，景安被以威恩，咸得寧輯，比至武平末，招慰生蠻輸租賦者數萬戶。六年，徵拜領軍大將軍。入周，以大將軍、大義郡開國公率衆討稽胡，戰沒。子仁，武平末儀同三司、武衛，隋驃騎將軍。卒於丹陽太守。

sourceRange.text: 猛少有志氣，便習弓馬。永安三年，尒朱榮征為親信。至洛陽，榮被害，即從尒朱世隆出奔建州，仍從尒朱兆入洛。其年，又從兆討紇豆陵步藩，補都督。普泰元年，加征虜將軍、中散大夫。猛父母兄弟皆在山東，尒朱京纏欲投高祖，謂猛曰：「王以爾父兄皆在山東，每懷不信，爾若不走，今夜必當殺爾，可走去。」猛以素蒙兆恩，拒而不從。京纏曰：「我今亦欲去，爾從我不？」猛又不從。京纏乃舉矟曰：「爾不從，我必刺爾。」猛乃從之。去城五十餘里，即背京纏復歸尒朱。及兆敗，乃歸高祖。高祖問曰：「尒朱京纏將爾投我，爾中路背去何也？」猛乃具陳服事之理，不可貳心。高祖曰：「爾莫懼，服事人法須如此。」遂補都督。

sourceRange.text: 從祖兄長粲。父僧敬，即魏孝靜帝之舅，位至司空。長粲少而敏悟，以外戚起家給事中，遷黃門侍郎。後主踐祚，長粲被勑與黃門馮子琮出入禁中，專典敷奏。世祖崩，與領軍婁定遠、錄尚書趙彥深、和士開、高文遙、領軍綦連猛、高阿那肱、樸射唐邕同知朝政，時人號為八貴。於後定遠、文遙並出，唐邕專典外兵，綦連猛、高阿那肱別總武任，長粲常在左右，兼宣詔令，從幸晉陽。後主即位，富於春秋，庶事皆歸委長粲，長粲盡心毗奉，甚得名譽。又為侍中。長仁心欲入處機要之地，為執政不許，長仁疑長粲通謀，大以為恨。遂言於太后，發其陰私，請出為州，後主不得已從焉。除趙州刺史。及辭，長粲流涕，後主亦憫默。至州，因沐髮手不得舉，失音，卒。
